a: Yetzia dichvota ka memaet.

Veha la damya hay yetzia lehay yetzia, hatam nafka la mershut adon ligmare, vehacha akkatti michassera mesira lechuppa! bahafarat nedarim miha nafka la mershuteh. ditnan: naara hameorasa aviha uvalah mefirin nedareha.
Vehay "veyatza chinnam" lehachi hu daata? ha mibbee leh lechidtanya, detanya: "veyatza chinnam" – ellu yeme bagrut, "en kasef" – ellu yeme naarut.
Amar ravina: im ken, lema kera "en kasef". may "en kasef" – en kesef leadon ze aval yesh kesef leadon acher, uman nihu – av.
Umimmay dedarshinan hachi – detanya: "vezera en lah"
– En li ella zarah. zera zarah minnayin? talmud lomar "zera en lah" – ayyen lah. veen li ella zera kasher. zera pasul minnayin? talmud lomar "zera en lah" – ayyen lah.
Veha appekteh lezera zarah! zera zarah la itzterich kera, divne vanim hare hen kevanim. ki itzterich kera – lezera pasul.
Vetanna gufeh menaleh dedaresh hachi? amri: ketiv "meen bilam" umeen yevami", dela ketiv behu yod. vehacha, ketiv beh yod – shema minna lidrasha hu daata.

Veitzterich lemichtav kiddusheha leaviha, veitzterich lemichtav maase yadeha leaviha. dei ketav rachamana kiddusheha leaviha, hava amena mishshum dela tarcha behu, aval maase yadeha deka tarcha behu ema dida havu.
Vei ashmeinan maase yadeha, deka mittazna minneh, aval kiddusheha demealma kaate la ema dida havu, tzericha.
Gufa: "veyatza chinnam" – ellu yeme bagrut, "en kesef" – ellu yeme naarut. velichtov rachamana naarut, vela bae bagrut!
Amar rabba: ba ze velimmed al ze.
Midde dehave attoshav vesachir. detanya: "toshav" – ze kanuy kinyan olam, "sachir" – ze kanuy kinyan shanim.
Yeamer "toshav" velo yeamer "sachir", vaani omer: kanuy kinyan olam eno ochel, kanuy kinyan shanim lo kol shekken?
Illu ken, hayiti omer: "toshav" – ze kanuy kinyan shanim. aval kenuy kinyan olam – ochel. ba "sachir" velimmed al "toshav", sheaf al pi shekkanuy kinyan olam – eno ochel.

Amar leh abbaye: mi dame? hatam tere gufe ninhu, dechi name ketav rachamana "toshav nirtza lo yochal" vahadar ketav iddach, hava sachir milleta deatya bekal vachomer, umilleta deatya bekal vachomer tarach vechatav la kera.
Ella hacha, chad gufa hi – ki nafka la benaarut, bagrut may baaya gabbeh?
Ella amar abbaye: lo nitzrecha ella leveger deaylonit,
Salka datach amena: benaarut tippok, bevagrut la tippok, ka mashma lan.
Matkef la mar bar rav ashe: velav kal vachomer hu? uma simanin sheen motziin mershut av – motziin mershut adon, bagrut shemmotzia mershut av – eno din shemmotzia mershut adon?
Ella amar mar bar rav ashe: lo nitzrecha ella leikkar zevina deaylonit, salka datach amena: deatya simane naarut – have zevina, dela atya simane naarut – la have zevina zevina,
b: Ka mashma lan "veyatza chinnam kulei".
Ulemar bar rav ashe, deamar: velav kal vachomer hu, ha amrinan milleta deatya bekal vachomer tarach vechatav la kera! hane mille hecha delekka leshannoye, aval hecha deikka leshannoye – meshanninan.

Vetanna mayyte la mehacha, detanya: "ki yikkach ish ishsha uvealah vehaya im lo timtza chen beenav ki matza vah vegomer" – en kicha ella bechesef. vechen hu omer: "natatti kesef hassade kach mimmenni".
Vahalo din hu: uma ama haivriyya sheenah niknet bevia – niknet bechesef, zo, shenniknet bevia – eno din shettikkane bechesef?
Yevama tochiach, shenniknet bevia veenah niknet bechesef! ma livama, shekken en niknet bishtar, tomar bezo, shenniknet bishtar!
Talmud lomar: "ki yikkach ish". ha lema li kera, ha atya la! amar rav ashe: mishshum deikka lememar meikkara dedina pircha.
Mehecha ka mayytet la – meama haivriyya. ma leama haivriyya, shekken yotza bechesef, tomar bezo, sheenah yotza bechesef. talmud lomar "ki yikkach ish".
Veitzterich lemichtav "veyatza chinnam", veitzterich lemichtav "ki yikkach ish". dei ketav rachamana "ki yikkach", hava amena: kiddushin dihav la baal – dida havu, ketav rachamana "veyatza chinnam".
Vei ketav rachamana "veyatza chinnam", hava amena: hecha deyahava leh ihi ledideh vekiddeshattu – havu kiddushe, ketav rachamana "ki yikkach" – vela "ki tikkach".
"Uvealah" – melammed shenniknet bevia. vahalo din hu: uma yevama sheen niknet bechesef – niknet bevia, zo, shenniknet bechesef – eno din shenniknet bevia?
Ama haivriyya tochiach, shenniknet bechesef veen niknet bevia. ma leama haivriyya, sheen kinyanah leshum ishut, tomar bezo, shekkinyanah leshum ishut.
Talmud lomar: "uvealah". ulema li kera, ha atya la! amar rav ashe: mishshum deikka lememar meikkara dedina pircha: mehecha ka mayytet la – miyyevama.
Ma livama, shekken zekuka veomedet, tomar bazo, sheen zekuka veomedet. talmud lomar: "uvealah".

a: Uminnayin sheaf bishtar? vedin hu: uma kesef, sheen motzi – machnis, shetar, shemmotzi – eno din shemmachnis?
Ma lechesef, shekken podin bo hekdesh umaaser sheni. tomar shetar, sheen podin bo hekdesh umaaser sheni, dichtiv: "venatan hakkesef vekam lo"!
Amar kera: "veyatza" "vehayta" – makkish havaya litzia: ma yetzia bishtar – af havaya name bishtar. veakkesh name, yetzia lahavaya: ma havaya bakkesef – af yetzia bechesef!
Amar abbaye: yomru: kesef machnis, kesef motzi, sanegor yease kategor? i hachi, shetar name yomru: shetar motzi, shetar machnis, kategor yease sanegor?
Mille dehay shetara lechod umille dehay shetara lechod. hacha name, hay kaspa lechod vehay kaspa lechod! tiva miha chad hu.
Rava amar: amar kera: "vechatav lah" bichtiva mitgareshet, veenah mitgareshet bechesef. veema: bichtiva mitgareshet – veenah mitkaddeshet bichtiva! ha ketiv "veyatza" "vehayta" makkish vechulei.
Uma raita? mistabbera kae begerushin memaet gerushin, kae begerushin umemaet kiddushin?!
Ulerabbi yose haggelili, deappek leh lehay kera lidrasha acharina, sheenah mitgareshet bechesef mena leh? amar kera: "sefer keritut" – sefer kortah, veen davar acher kortah.
Verabbanan, hay "keritut", may avdi leh? mibbee leh ledavar hakkoret beno levenah,
Kidtanya: "hare ze gittech al menat shello tishti yayin", "al menat shello telchi levet avich leolam" – en ze keritut. "kol sheloshim yom" – hare ze keritut.
Verabbi yose haggelili? mikkaret keritut ka nafka leh. verabbanan? karet keritut la mashma lehu.
Chada mechada la atya, tete chada mittarte! he tete? la lichtov rachamana bishtar, vetete mehanach – ma lehanach shekken hanaatan merubba.
La nichtov rachamana bevia, vetete mehanach – ma lehanach shekken kinyanan merubbe.
La nichtov rachamana bechesef, vetete mehanach – ma lehanach shekken yeshnan beal korchah.
Vechi tema kesef name beal korchah, beama haivriyya – beishut miha la ashkechan.
Amar rav huna: chuppa kona mikkal vachomer: uma kesef sheeno maachil bitruma – kone, chuppa shemmaachelet bitruma – eno din shettikne?
Vechesef eno maachil? vehaamar ulla: devar tora, arusa bat yisrael ochelet bitruma, shenneemar: "vechohen ki yikne nefesh kinyan kaspo", vehay "kinyan kaspo hu".
Uma taam amru enah ochelet – gezera shemma yimzegu lah kos bevet aviha vetashkennu leachiha velaachotay.
Ella perech hachi: uma kesef sheeno gomer – kone,
b: Chuppa sheggomeret – eno din shettikne? ma lechesef, shekken podin bo hekdeshot umaaser sheni. bia tochiach.

Ma levia, shekken kona bivama. kesef yochiach. vechazar haddin: lo rei ze chiri ze, velo rei ze kiri ze, hatztzad hashshave shebbahen: shekkonin bealma vekonin kan, af ani avi chuppa shekkona bealma, vekona kan.
Ma letzad hashshave shebbahen, shekken hanaatan merubba. shetar yochiach. ma lishtar, shekken motzi bevat yisrael. kesef uvia yochichu.
Vechazar haddin: lo rei ze kiri ze, velo rei ze kiri ze, hatztzad hashshave shebbahen: shekkonin bealma vekonin kan – af ani avi chuppa, shekkona bealma vekona kan.
Ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen, shekken yeshnan beal korchah. verav huna – kesef miha beishut la ashkechan beal korchah.
Amar rava: shete teshuvot baddavar. chada, deshalosh" tenan vearba" la tenan.
Veod: kelum chuppa gomeret ella al yede kiddushin, vechi gamrinan chuppa shello al yede kiddushin mechuppa sheal yede kiddushin?
Amar leh abbaye: ha dekaamrat "shalosh" tenan vearba" la tenan – tanna milleta dichtiva behedya katane, milleta dela ketiva behedya la katane.
Udekaamrat "kelum chuppa gomeret ella al yede kiddushin" – rav huna name hachi kaamar: uma kesef sheeno gomer achar kesef – kone, chuppa sheggomeret achar kesef – eno din shettikne?

Tanu rabbanan: ketzad bechesef? natan lah kesef o shave kesef, veamar lah: "hare at mekuddeshet li", "hare at meoreset li", "hare at li leintu" – hare zo mekuddeshet. aval hi shennatna, veamra hi: "hareni mekuddeshet lecha", "hareni meoreset lecha", "hareni lecha leintu" – enah mekuddeshet.

Matkef la rav pappa: tama denatan hu veamar hu, ha natan hu veamra hi – enah mekuddeshet. ema sefa: aval hi shennatna lo veamra hi – la havu kiddushin. tama denatna hi veamra hi, ha natan hu veamra hi – havu kiddushin!
Resha davka, sefa kedi nasva. vetane sefa milleta desatra la leresha?

Ella hachi kaamar: natan hu veamar hu – peshita dehavu kiddushin. natan hu veamra hi – naasa kemi shennatna hi veamra hi, vela havu kiddushin. vei baet ema: natan hu veamar hu – mekuddeshet. natna hi veamra hi – enah mekuddeshet. natan hu veamra hi – sefeka hi vechayyshinan midderabbanan.

Amar shemuel: bekiddushin, natan lah kesef veshave kesef veamar lah: "hare at mekuddeshet", "hare at meoreset", "hare at (li) leintu" – hare zo mekuddeshet. "hareni ishshech", "hareni balech", "hareni arusech" – en kan bet mechosh.

Vechen begerushin, natan lah veamar lah: "hare at meshullachat", "hare at megoreshet", "hare at mutteret lechol adam" – hare zo megoreshet. "eni ishshech", "eni balech", "eni arusech" – en kan bet mechosh.
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: lememra desavar shemuel yadayim sheen mochichot, havyayn yadayim?
Vehatnan: haomer "ehe" – hare ze nazir. vehavenan ba: vedilma "ehe betaanit" kaamar? veamar shemuel, vehu shehaya nazir over lefanav. tama dinzir over lefanav, ha lav hachi – la!
Hacha bemay askinan, deamar "li". i hachi, may kamashma lan? hane

a: Lishshane batrae ka mashma lan: hacha ketiv "ki yikkach" – velo sheyyakkach et atzmo. vehacha ketiv "veshillechah" – velo sheyyeshallach et atzmo.

Tanu rabbanan: "hare at ishti", "hare at arusati", "hare at kenuya li" – mekuddeshet. "hare at shelli", "hare at birshuti", "hare at zekuka li" – mekuddeshet. velitninhu kullehu kachada! tanna telat telat, shaminhu vegarsinhu.
Ibbaya lehu: "meyuchedet li" mahu? "meyoedet li" mahu? "ezrati" mahu? "negdati" mahu? "atzurati" mahu? "tzalati" mahu? "segurati" mahu? "tachtay" mahu? "tefusati" mahu? "lekuchati" mahu?
Peshot miha chada, detanya: haomer "lekuchati" – hare zo mekuddeshet, mishshum "shenneemar ki yikkach ish ishsha".
Ibbaya lehu: "charufati" mahu? ta shema, detanya: haomer "charufati" – mekuddeshet, shekken bihuda korin laarusa "charufa". vihuda havya rubba dealma?

Hachi kaamar: haomer "charufati" – mekuddeshet, shenneemar: "vehi shifcha necherefet leish". veod, bihuda korin laarusa "charufa". vihuda veod likra? ella hachi kaamar: haomer "charufa" bihuda – mekuddeshet, shekken bihuda korin laarusa "charufa".
Bemay askinan? ilema besheen medabber immah al iske gittah vekiddusheha – mena yada may kaamar la? veella bimdabber immah al iske gittah vekiddusheha – af al gav dela amar lah name,

Ditnan: haya medabber im ishsha al iske gittah vekiddusheha, venatan lah gittah vekiddusheha velo peresh – rabbi yose omer: dayyo. rabbi yehuda omer: tzarich lefaresh. veamar rav huna amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi yose!
Amri: leolam bimdabber immah al iske gittah vekiddusheha, vei deyahev la veshatek hachi name, hacha bemay askinan dihav la vaamar la behane lishshane,
Vehachi ka mibbee leh: hane lishshane lekiddushe kaamar la, o dilma limlacha kaamar la? teku.

Gufa: haya medabber im haishsha al iske gittah vekiddusheha, venatan lah gittah vekiddusheha velo peresh – rabbi yose omer: dayyo. rabbi yehuda omer: tzarich lefaresh. amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: vehu sheasukin beoto inyan.
Vechen amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi oshaya: vehu sheasukin beoto inyan. ketannae: rabbi omer: vehu sheasukin beoto inyan. rabbi elazar bar rabbi shimon omer: af al pi sheen asukin beoto inyan.
Vei lav daasukin beoto inyan, mena yada may kaamar la? amar abbaye: meinyan leinyan beoto inyan.

Amar rav huna amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi yose. amar leh rav yemar lerav ashe: veella ha deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: kol sheeno yodea betiv gittin vekiddushin lo yehe lo esek immahem, afillu la shemia leh ha derav huna amar shemuel? amar leh: in, hachi name.

Vechen begerushin, natan lah gittah veamar lah: "hare at meshullachat" "hare at megoreshet", "hare at mutteret lechol adam" – hare hi megoreshet. peshita natan lah gittah, veamar lah leishto: "hare at bat chorin"
b: – Lo amar velo kelum. amar lah leshifchato: "hare at mutteret lechol adam" – lo amar velo kelum.
Amar lah leishto: "hare at leatzmecha" mahu? mi amrinan limlacha kaamar la, o dilma ligmare kaamar la?

Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: ta shema, detanya: gufo shel get shichrur: "hare atta ben chorin", "hare atta leatzmecha". hasheta uma eved kenaani dikne leh gufeh, ki amar leh "hare atta leatzmecha" – ligmare kaamar leh, ishsha dela kene leh gufa, lo kol shekken?
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: amar leavdo "en li esek becha" may? mi amrinan "en li esek becha" – ligmare kaamar leh, o dilma limlacha kaamar leh?
Amar leh rav nachman lerav ashe veamri la rav chanin machozaa lerav ashe: ta shema: hammocher avdo lenochri – yatza lecherut, vetzarich get shichrur merabbo rishon.

Amar rabban shimon ben gamliel: bamme devarim amurim – shello katav alav ono, aval katav alav ono – zehu shichruro. hechi dame ono? amar rav sheshet: dichtav leh: keshettivrach mimmennu – "en li esek becha".
Amar abbaye: hamekaddesh bemilve – enah mekuddeshet. bahanaat milve – mekuddeshet, veasur laasot ken mippene haaramat ribbit.
Hay hanaat milve, hechi dame? illema deazkefa, daamar la arba bechamsha – ha ribbit meallayyta hu. veod, hayeynu milve!
La tzericha, dearvavch la zimna.
Amar rava: "helach mane al menat shettachazirehu li" bemecher – lo kana, beishsha – enah mekuddeshet, befidyon habben – en beno paduy,
Bitruma – yatza yede netina. veasur laasot ken, mippene shennire kechohen hamesayyea bevet haggeranot.
May kasavar rava? i kasavar mattana al menat lehachazir shemah mattana – afillu kullehu name, vei kasavar lo shemah mattana – afillu teruma name la.
Veod, ha rava hu deamar: mattana al menat lehachazir shemah mattana! deamar rava: "helach etrog ze al menat shettachzirehu li" – netalo vehechziro – yatza. veim lav – lo yatza!
Ella amar rav ashe: bechullehu kane levar meishsha, lefi sheen ishsha niknet bachalifin. amar leh rav huna mar bereh derav nechemya lerav ashe: hachi amrinan mishshemeh derava kevotaych.
Amar rava: "ten mane lifloni

a: Veekkaddesh lach" – mekuddeshet, middin arev. arev, lav af al gav dela mate hanaa lideh – ka meshabed nafsheh, hay itteta name, af al gav dela mate hanaa lida – ka meshabeda umakneya nafsha.

"Helach mane vehitkaddeshi lifloni" – mekuddeshet, middin eved kenaani. eved kenaani, lav af al gav dela ka chaser vela midde – ka kane nafsheh, hay gavra name, af al gav dela ka chaser vela midde – ka kane la lehay itteta.

"Ten mane lifloni veekkaddesh ani lo" – mekuddeshet, middin shenehem. arev, lav af al gav dela ka mate hanaa lideh – ka meshabed nafsheh, hay itteta name, af al gav dela ka mate hanaa lida – ka makneya nafsha.
Mi dame? arev, hay deka kane leh ka chasar mamona, hay gavra ka kane la lehay itteta vela ka chasar vela midde! eved kenaani yochiach, dela ka chasar mamona veka kane nafsheh.
Mi dame? hatam hach deka makne ka kane, hacha hay itteta ka makneya nafsha vela ka kanya vela midde! arev yochiach, af al gav dela ka mate hanaa lideh meshabed nafsheh.

Bae rava: "helach mane veekkaddesh ani lach" mahu? amar mar zutera mishshemeh derav pappa: mekuddeshet. amar leh rav ashe lemar zutera: im ken, have leh nechasim sheyyesh lahem achrayut niknin im nechasim sheen lahem achrayut,

Vaanan ippecha tenan: nechasim sheen lahem achrayut niknin im nechasim sheyyesh lahem achrayut bechesef bishtar uvachazaka! amar leh: mi savrat deamra leh "aggav"? hacha beadam chashuv askinan, divhahi hanaa deka mekabbel mattana minna gamra umakneya leh nafsha.
Ittemar name mishshemeh derava: vechen leinyan mamona. utzericha,
Dei ashmoinan kiddushin, mishshum deha itteta nicha la bechol dehu kidresh lakish, deamar resh lakish: "tav lemetav tan du millemetav armelu." aval mamona – ema la.
Vei ashmoinan mamona, mishshum deityehiv limchilla, aval kiddushin, ema la, tzericha.

Amar rava: "hitkaddeshi li lechetzyi" – mekuddeshet. "chetzyech mekuddeshet li" – enah mekuddeshet. amar leh abbaye lerava: may shena "chetzyech mekuddeshet li" deenah mekuddeshet – "ishsha" amar rachamana velo chatzi ishsha, hachi name – "ish" amar rachamana velo chatzi ish!
Amar leh: hachi hasheta?! hatam, itteta leve tere la chazya, ella gavra mi la chaze leve tere? vehachi kaamar la – dei baena leminsav achariti – nasevna.
Amar leh mar zutera bereh derav mari leravina: venifshetu la kiddushe bechulla! mi la tanya: haomer: "raglah shel zo ola" – tehe kullah ola?
Vaafillu leman deamar en kullah ola, hane mille hecha demakdish davar sheen hanneshama teluya bo, aval makdish davar shehanneshama teluya bo – havya kullah ola.
Mi dame? hatam – behema, hacha – daat acheret.
Ha la damya ella leha deamar rabbi yochanan: behema shel shene shuttafin, hikdish chetzyah vechazar ulekachah vehikdishah – kedosha, veenah kereva,
Veosa temura, utemuratah kayyotze bah.
Shema minna telat:
b: Shema minna baale chayyim nidchim,
Ushema minna dachuy meikkara have dachuy, ushema minna yesh dichuy bedamim.
Bae rava: "chetzyech bachatzi feruta, vechetzyech bachatzi feruta" mahu? kevan deamar la "chatzi feruta" – paska, o dilma mone veholech hu?
Im timtze lomar mone veholech hu, "chetzyech bifruta vechetzyech bifruta" mahu? kevan deamar la bifruta uferuta – paska lemilleteh, o dilma kol beyomeh mone veholech hu?

Im timtze lomar kol beyomeh mone veholech hu, "chetzyech bifruta hayyom vechetzyech bifruta lemachar" mahu? kevan deamar la lemachar – paska, o dilma hachi kaamar la: "kiddushin matchalu mehaiddana umigmar la nigmeru ad limchar"?
"Shene chatzayayich bifruta" mahu? hacha vadday bechad zimna kaamar la, o dilma en ishsha mitkaddeshet lachatzain kelal? teku.
Bae rava: "shete venotecha lishne vanay bifruta" mahu? batar noten umekabbel azlinan vehaikka mamona, o dilma batar didhu azlinan veha lekka? teku.
Bae rav pappa: "bittecha ufaratcha bifruta" mahu? mi amrinan bittecha bachatzi feruta ufaratcha bachatzi feruta, o dilma bittecha bifruta ufaratcha bimshicha? teku.
Bae rav ashe: "bittecha vekarkaacha bifruta" mahu? bittecha bachatzi feruta vekarkaacha bachatzi feruta, o dilma bittecha bifruta vekarkaacha bachazaka? teku.
Hahu gavra dekaddesh beshirae, rabba amar: la tzerichi shuma. rav yosef amar: tzerichi shuma. i deamar la bechol dehu, kulle alma la peligi dela tzerichi shuma.

I deamar la "chamshin" vela shavu chamshin – ha la shavu. ki peligi, deamar "chamshin" veshavu chamshin. rabba amar: la tzerichi shuma, deha shavu chamshin. rav yosef amar: tzerichi shuma, kevan deitteta la bekia beshuma la samcha data.
Ikka deamri bechol dehu name peligi. rav yosef amar: shave kesef hare hu kechesef, ma kesef dekitz –

a: Af shave kesef name dekitz.
Amar rav yosef: mena amena la, detanya: "mikkesef miknato" – bechesef hu nikne, veeno nikne bitvua vechelim.
Hay tevua vechelim hechi dame? illema dela maknu behu kelal, "yashiv geullato" amar rachamana – lerabbot shave kesef kechesef;
Vei delet behu shave peruta, may irya tevua vechelim, afillu kesef name! ella lav deit behu shave peruta, vechevan dela kayytzi la?
Veiddach, hachi kaamar: betorat kesef hu nikne, veen nikne betorat tevua vechelim, umay ninhu – chalifin.
Ulerav nachman, deamar: perot la avdi chalifin, may ikka lememar? ella, leolam delet behu shave peruta. udekaamrat "may irya tevua, vechelim afillu kesef name!", la mibbaya kaamar:
La mibbaya kesef, dei it beh shave peruta – in, i la – la, aval tevua vechelim, ema middimkarva hanaatayyhu, gamar umakne nafsheh, ka mashma lan.

Amar rav yosef: mena amena la, detanya: "egel ze lefidyon beni", "tallit zo lefidyon beni" – lo amar kelum. "egel ze bechamesh selaim lefidyon beni", "tallit zo bechamesh selaim lefidyon beni" – beno paduy.
Hay pidyon, hechi dame? illema dela shave, kol keminneh? ella lav af al gav deshave, vechevan dela kayytzi – la?
La, leolam dela shave, uchegon dekabbel kohen illaveh. ki ha derav kahana shakel sudara mibbe pidyon habben, amar (leh): ledidi chaze li chamesh selaim.
Amar rav ashe: la amaran ella kegon rav kahana, degavra rabba hu umibbee leh sudara aresheh, aval kulle alma – la. ki ha demar bar rav ashe zevan sudara meimmeh derava mikkubbe shave asra bitlesar.
Amar rabbi elazar: "hitkaddeshi li bemane", venatan lah dinar – hare zo mekuddeshet, veyashlim. may tama? kevan deamar la "mane" veyahev la dinar, keman deamar la: "al menat" dame.
Veamar rav huna amar rav: kol haomer "al menat" keomer "meachshav" dame.
Metivi: "hitkaddeshi li bemane", vehaya mone veholech, veratza echad mehen lachazor afillu baddinar haacharon – harshut beyado.
Hacha bemay askinan, deamar "bemane ze". ha middesefa "bemane ze", resha bemane setam,
Deka tane sefa: amar lah "hitkaddeshi li bemane ze" venimtza mane chaser dinar, o dinar shel nechoshet – enah mekuddeshet. dinar ra – hare zo mekuddeshet, veyachlif.
La, resha vesefa deamar "bemane ze", ufaroshe ka mefaresh: ratza echad mehen lachazor, afillu bedinar haacharon – harshut beyado. ketzad – kegon deamar la "bemane zo".
Vehachi name mistabbera, dei salka datach resha bemane setam, hasheta bemane setam la havu kiddushe, "bemane ze" mibbaya?

I mishshum ha la irya – tena sefa legalloye resha, shello tomar resha "bemane ze", aval bemane setam havu kiddushin, tena sefa "bemane ze", mikkelal deresha bemane setam, vaafillu hachi la havu kiddushin.
Rav ashe amar: mone veholech shane, dedata akkulleh.
Hay dinar shel nechoshet, hechi dame? i deyada beh – ha sevara vekabbila! la tzericha, deyahaveh nihalay belelya, i name deishtechach lay bene zuze.
Hay dinar ra hechi dame? i dela nafek – hayeynu dinar shel nechoshet! amar rav pappa: kegon denafek al yede haddechak.
Amar rava amar rav nachman: amar la "hitkaddeshi li bemane", vehinniach lah mashkon alehe[40] – enah mekuddeshet,
b: Mane en kan – mashkon en kan. etiveh rava lerav nachman: kiddesha bemashkon mekuddeshet! hatam bemashkon daacherim vechidrabbi yitzchak.
Deamar rabbi yitzchak: minnayin levaal chov shekkone mashkon – shenneemar: "ulecha tihye tzedaka" – im eno kone, tzedaka minnayin? mikkan levaal chov shekkone mashkon.
Bene rav huna bar avin zevun hahi amta bifrite, la havo bahadayyhu, otivu nesacha aleh. lesof iyyaykkar amta. ato lekammeh derabbi amme, amar lehu: perite en kan, nesacha en kan.
Tanu rabbanan: "hitkaddeshi li bemane", netalattu uzerakattu layyam o laur o lechol davar haaved – enah mekuddeshet. ha shedetinhu kammeh – havu kiddushin? ha kaamra leh: shekel, la baena!

La mibbaya ka amar: la mibbaya shedetinhu kammeh dela havu kiddushin, aval zerakattu layyam o laur ema kevan demichayyeyva behu, kaddoshe kaddish nafshah, veha deka avda hachi, savra: evdekeh lehay gavra i ratchana hu o la, ka mashma lan.
Tanu rabbanan: "hitkaddeshi li bemane" – "tenem, leabba uleavicha" – enah "mekuddeshet. "al menat sheyyekabbelum li" – mekuddeshet.
Tena abba lehodiacha koach deresha, tena avicha lehodiacha koach desefa.
"Hitkaddeshi li bemane" – "tenem lifloni" – enah mekuddeshet. "al menat sheyyekabbelem li" – mekuddeshet. utzericha,
Dei ashmeinan "abba veavich", hatam hu dechi amra "al menat sheyyekabbelum li" – havu kiddushin, desamcha data illa[va]yehu, savra: avdin li shelichutay. aval peloni – la,

Vei ashmeinan peloni, hacha hu dechi amra "tenem lifloni" – la havu kiddushe, dela mekarva data legabbeh lemitteve leh bemattana, aval "abba veavich", dimkarva data legabbayyhu, ema bemattana yahaviteh nihalayyhu, tzericha.
Tanu rabbanan: "hitkaddeshi li bemane" – "tenem al gabbe sela" – enah mekuddeshet. veim haya sela shellah – mekuddeshet. bae rav bivi: sela shel shenehem, mahu? teku.
"Hitkaddeshi li bechikkar" – "tenehu lechelev" – enah mekuddeshet. veim haya kelev shellah – mekuddeshet. bae rav mari: kelev ratz achareha, mahu?
Behahu hanaa deka matztzela nafshah minneh gamra umakneya leh nafshah, o dilma matze amra leh: "middeorayyta chayyove mechayyeyvat laatzulan"? teku.
"Hitkaddeshi li bechikkar" – "tenehu leani" – enah mekuddeshet, afillu ani hassamuch aleha. may tama? amra leh: ki hechi dimchayyayvna beh ana, hachi mechayyeyvat beh at.
Hahu gavra dahava ka mezabben

a: Chumere petachyayta. atay hahi itteta, amara leh: "hav li chad socha". amar la: "i yahavina lich mikkaddeshat li"? amara leh: "hava mehava". amar rav chama: kol "hava mehava" lav kelum hu.

Hahu gavra dahava ka shate chamra bechanuta. atay hahi itteta, amara leh: "hav li chad kasa". amar la: "i yahevna lich mikkaddeshat li"? amara leh: "ashkoye ashkeyayn". amar rav chama: kol "ashkoye ashkeyayn" lav kelum hu.

Hahu gavra dahava ka shade tamre middikla. atay hahi itteta, amara leh: "shedi li tarte"! amar la: "i shadena lich mikkaddeshat li"? amara leh: "shedi mishda". amar rav zevid: kol "shedi mishda" lav kelum hu.
Ibbaya lehu: "hav", "ashki", "ushedi", mahu? – amar ravina: mekuddeshet. rav samma bar rakta amar: taga demalka! enah mekuddeshet. vehilcheta: enah mekuddeshet.
Vehilcheta: shirae la tzerichi shuma. vehilcheta kerabbi elazar, vehilcheta kerava amar rav nachman.
Tanu rabbanan: bishtar ketzad? katav lo al hanneyayr o al hacheres, af al pi sheen bo shave feruta, "bittecha mekuddeshet li", "bittecha meoreset li", "bittecha li leintu" – hare zo mekuddeshet.
Matkef la rabbi zera bar memel: ha la dame hay shetara lishtar zevine! hatam, mocher kotev lo "sadi mechura lach", hacha baal kotev "bittecha mekuddeshet li"!
Amar rava: hatam meinyayna dikra vehacha meinyayna dikra. hatam ketiv "umachar meachuzzato" – bemocher tela rachamana, hacha ketiv "ki yikkach" – bevaal tela rachamana.
Hatam name ketiv "sadot bakkesef yiknu"! keri beh "yaknu". may tama karet beh "yaknu" – mishshum dichtiv "umachar", hachi name keri beh "ki yakkach", dichtiv "et bitti natatti laish hazze".
Ella amar rava: hilcheta ninhu veasmechinhu rabbanan akkerae. veibbaet ema: hatam name ketiv "vaekkach et sefer hammikna".

Veamar rava amar rav nachman: katav lo al hanneyayr o al hacheres, af al pi sheen bo shave feruta, "bittecha mekuddeshet li", "bittecha meoreset li", "bittecha li leintu", ben al yede aviha ben al yede atzmah – mekuddeshet middato, vehu shello bagra.

Katav lah al hanneyayr o al hacheres, af al pi sheen bo shave feruta, "hare at mekuddeshet li", "hare at li leintu", "hare at meoreset li" – mekuddeshet, ben al yede aviha, ben al yede atzmah, middatah, vehu shebbagra.
Bae rabbi shimon ben lakish: shetar erusin shekketavo shello lishmah, mahu? havayot litziot makkeshinan, ma
b: Yetzia baenan lishmah – af havayay baenan lishmah, o dilma havayot lahadade makkeshinan, ma havayay dechesef la baenan lishmah – af havayay dishtar la baenan lishmah?
Batar devaya hadar pashta: havayay litzia makkeshinan, deamar kera "veyatza" "vehayta".

Ittemar: ketavo lishmah, veshello middatah – rava veravina amri: mekuddeshet. rav pappa verav sherevya amri: enah mekuddeshet. amar rav pappa: ema tama didhu veema tama didi. ema tama didhu – dichtiv: "veyatza" "vehayta" – makkish havayay litzia, ma yetzia lishmah veshello middatah, af havayay name lishmah veshello middatah.
Veema tama didi: "veyatza" "vehayta" – makkish havayay litzia, ma yetzia baenan daat makne, af havayay baenan daat makne.
Metivi: en kotvin shetare erusin venissuin ella middaat shenehen. may lav shetare erusin venissuin mammash! la, shetare pesikata. vechidrav giddel amar rav,
Deamar rav giddel amar rav: "kamma atta noten levincha"? – "kach vechach", "levittecha"? – "kach vechach", amdu vekiddeshu – kanu, hen hen haddevarim hanniknim baamira.

Uvevia. mena lan? amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan: deamar kera "beulat baal" – melammed shennaase lah baal al yede veila. amar leh rabbi zera lerabbi avahu veamri la resh lakish lerabbi yochanan: keura zo sheshshana rabbi "uvealah" – melammed shenniknet bevia?
I mehatam, hava amena ad dimkaddesh vahadar bael, ka mashma lan.
Matkef la rabbi abba bar memel: im ken, naara hameorasa, deamar rachamana biskila, hechi mashkachat la?
I dekaddesh vahadar beel beula hi, i dekaddesh vela beel lav kelum hu! amruha rabbanan kammeh deabbaye: mashkachat la, kegon shebba aleha arus shello kedarkah.
Amar lehu abbaye: ad kan la peligi rabbi verabbanan ella beacher, aval baal – divre hakkol im ba aleha shello kedarkah – asaah beula!
May hi? detanya: bau aleha asara anashim, vaadayin hi betula – kullan biskila. rabbi omer, omer ani: harishon biskila, vechullan bechenek.
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: mashkachat la kegon shekkiddeshah bishtar, hoil vegomer umotzi, gomer umachnis.
Verabbi yochanan, hay "uvealah", may aved leh? hahu mibbee leh – zo niknet bevia, veen ama haivriyya niknet bevia.
Salka datach amena tete bekal vachomer mivama: uma yevamah sheen niknet bechesef, niknet bevia, zo, shenniknet bechesef, eno din shenniknet bevia?
Ma livama, shekken zekuka veomedet. salka datach amena: hoil uchetiv "im acheret yikkach lo", hikkishah hakkatuv leacheret. ma acheret mikkanya bevia – af ama haivriyya mikkanya bevia, ka mashma lan.
Verabbi, hay sevara mena leh? im ken lichtov rachamana "uvaal", may "uvealah" – shema minna tarte.
Ulerava deamar: bar ahina asbera li: "ki yikkach ish ishsha uvealah" – kiddushin hamesurin levia havu kiddushin, kiddushin sheen mesurin levia la havu kiddushin. may ikka lememar?
Im ken nichtov kera "o vealah", may "uvealah" – shema minna kullehu.
Verabbi, hay "beulat baal", may aved leh? hay mibbee leh – baal ose otah beula shello kedarkah, veen acher ose otah beula shello kedarkah.
Umi it leh lerabbi hay sevara? vehatanya: bau aleha asara anashim vaadayin hi betula – kullam biskila. rabbi omer: omer ani harishon biskila, vechullam bechenek!

a: Amar rabbi zera: mode rabbi leinyan kenas dechullehu meshallemi. may shena mikketala? shane hatam, deamar kera: "umet haish asher shachav immah levaddo".
Verabbanan hay "levaddo" may avdi leh? mibbee lehu lechidtanya, "umetu gam shenehem" – ad sheyyihyu shavin keechad, divre rabbi oshaya. rabbi yonatan omer: "umet haish asher shachav immah levaddo".
Verabbi yochanan, hay sevara mena leh? im ken nichtov kera "beulat ish", may "beulat baal" – shema minna tarte.
Ibbaya lehu: techillat bia kona o sof bia kona? nafka minna kegon sheheera bah, ufashta yadah vekibbela kiddushin meacher.
I name, lechohen gadol deka kane betula bevia, may? amar ammemar mishshemeh derava: kol habboel – dato al gemar bia.
Ibbaya lehu: bia nissuin osa, o erusin osa? nafka minna – leyorshah,
Velitamme lah, ulehafer nedareha. i amrat nissuin osa – yorshah umittamme lah umefer nedareha, vei amrat erusin osa – eno yorshah veeno mittamme lah veeno mefer nedareha. may?

Amar abbaye: ta shema: haav zakkay bevitto bekiddusheha bechesef bishtar uvevia, vezakkay bimtziatah uvemaase yadeha, uvahafarat nedareha, umekabbel et gittah, veeno ochel perot bechayyeha. nisset – yater alav habbaal sheochel perot bechayyeha.
Katane "bia", vekatane "nisset"! ki katane "nisset" – ashsheara.
Amar rava: ta shema: bat shalosh shanim veyom echad mitkaddeshet bevia, veim ba aleha yavam – kenaah, vechayyayvin aleha mishshum eshet ish, umetammea et boalah
b: Letamme mishkav tachton keelyon,
Veim nisset lechohen – ochelet bitruma, veim ba aleha echad mikkol arayot shebbattora – mumatin al yadah, vehi petura. veim ba aleha echad min happesulin – pesalah min hakkehunna.
Katane "bia", vekatane "nisset"! hachi kaamar: i hane nissuin dechohen ninhu – ochelet bitruma.

Ta shema: uchevar shalach yochanan ben bag bag etzel rabbi yehuda ben betira lintzivin: shamati alecha sheatta omer arusa bat yisrael ochelet bitruma. shalach lo: veatta i atta omer ken? muchezkani becha sheatta baki bechadre tora, lidrosh bekal vachomer i atta yodea?!

Uma shifcha kenaanit, sheen biatah maachilatah bitruma – kaspah maachilatah bitruma, zo, shebbiatah maachilatah bitruma – eno din shekkaspah maachilatah bitruma? aval ma eese shehare amru chachamim: en arusa bat yisrael ochelet bitruma ad shettikkanes lachuppa.
Hechi dame? i bevia sheal yede chuppa, vechesef sheal yede chuppa – betarvayyhu mechol achla!
Veella, bevia sheal yede chuppa, vechesef shello al yede chuppa – hacha tarte, vehacha chada! ella lav bevia shello al yede chuppa, vechesef shello al yede chuppa.
I amrat bishlama nissuin osa – mishshum hachi peshita leh daalima la bia mikkesef. ella i amrat kiddushin osa, may shena hacha difshita leh, umay shena hacha dimsappeka leh?
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: leolam ema lach bevia sheal yede chuppa vechesef shello al yede chuppa. udekaamrat: "hacha tarte vehacha chada" – kal vachomer miha iteh;

Vehachi shelach leh: uma shifcha kenaanit, sheen biatah maachilatah bitruma afillu al yede chuppa – kaspah maachilatah belo chuppa, zo, shebbiatah maachilatah bitruma al yede chuppa – eno din shekkaspah maachilatah bitruma belo chuppa?
Aval ma eese shehare amru chachamim: en arusa bat yisrael ochelet bitruma ad shettikkanes lachuppa, mishshum deulla.
Uven bag bag? gabbe shifcha kenaanit la shayyayr bekinyana, hacha, shayyer bekinyana.
Ravina amar: middeorayyta – mifshat peshita leh deachla, umidderabbanan hu dishlach leh.

Vehachi shelach leh: shamati alecha sheatta omer arusa bat yisrael ochelet bitruma, vela chayyshat lesimpon. shelach leh: veatta i atta omer ken? muchezkani becha sheatta baki bechadre tora, lidrosh bekal vachomer i atta yodea?!

Uma shifcha kenaanit sheen biatah maachilatah bitruma – kaspah maachilatah bitruma, vela chayyshinan lesimpon, zo shebbiatah maachilatah bitruma – eno din shekkaspah maachilatah bitruma, velo nechush lesimpon? aval ma eese shehare amru chachamim: arusa bat yisrael enah ochelet bitruma

a: Ad shettikkanes lachuppa, mishshum deulla.
Uven bag bag? simpon, baavadim let leh. i mumin shebbaggaluy hu – ha ka chaze leh. i mishshum mumin shebbasseter – may nafka leh minneh? limlacha ka vae leh la ichpat leh.
Nimtza gannav o kuveyusetus – higgio. may amrat, listim mezuyyayn o (nichtav) [muchetav] lammalchut? hanhu kala it lehu!
Mikkedi, ben lemar uven lemar la achla, may benayyhu?
Ikka benayyhu: kibbel, masar, vehalach.
Bechesef, bet shammay omrim bedinar vechulei. may tamayyhu devet shammay? amar rabbi zera: shekken ishsha makpedet al atzmah, veen mitkaddeshet befachot middinar.

Amar leh abbaye: ella meatta, kegon benateh derabbi yannay, dekafdan annafshayyhu, vela mikkaddeshan befachot mittarkeva dedinare, hachi name dei pashta yadah vekibbela chad zuza meacher, hachi name dela havu kiddushin?
Amar leh: pashta yadah vekibbelah la kaamena, ki kaamena, dekaddesha belelya, i name deshavviya shaliach.
Rav yosef amar: tamayhu devet shammay kidrav yehuda amar rav assi. deamar rav yehuda amar rav assi: kol kesef haamur battora – kesef tzori, veshel divrehem – kesef medina.
Gufa, amar rav yehuda amar rav assi: kol kesef haamur battora – kesef tzori, veshel divrehem – kesef medina. uchelala hu?
b: Vahare taana, dichtiv: "ki yitten ish el reehu kesef o chelim lishmor", utenan: shevuat haddayyaynin, hattaana – shete kesef, vehahodaa – shave feruta.
Hatam dumeya dechelim, ma kelim shenayim – af kesef shenayim, uma kesef davar chashuv – af kelim davar chashuv.
Vahare maaser, dichtiv: "vetzarta hakkesef beyadcha", utenan: happoret sela mimmeot maaser sheni! "kesef" "hakkesef" – ribba.
Vahare hekdesh, dichtiv: "venatan hakkesef vekam lo", veamar shemuel: hekdesh shave mane shechillelo al shave feruta – mechullal! hatam name, "kesef" "kesef" yalef mimmaaser.
Vahare kiddushe ishsha, dichtiv: "ki yikkach ish ishsha uvealah", vegamar "kicha" "kicha" missede efron, utenan: bet hillel omrim: bifruta uveshave feruta. nema rav assi deamar kevet shammay?!
Ella i ittemar, hachi ittemar: amar rav yehuda amar rav assi: kol kesef katzuv haamur battora – kesef tzori, veshel divrehem – kesef medina.
May ka mashma lan? tenena: chamesh selaim shel ben, sheloshim shel eved, chamishshim shel ones veshel mefatte, mea shel motzi shem ra – kullam beshekel hakkodesh, bemane tzori!

"Veshel divrehem kesef medina" itztericha leh, dela tenan. detanya: hattokea lachavero – noten lo sela. vela tema may sela – arbea zuze, ella may sela – palga dezuza, daavidi inashe dekaru lefalga dezuza istera.
Rabbi shimon ben lakish omer: tamayyhu devet shammay, kidchizkiyya. deamar chizkiyya: amar kera: "vehefdah" – melammed shemmegaraat mippidyonah, veyotza.

I amrat bishlama dihav la dinar – hayeynu dimgara veazla ad peruta, ella i amrat dihav la peruta, mipperuta mi megara? vedilma hachi kaamar rachamana: hecha dihav la dinar – teygara ad peruta, hecha dihav la peruta – la teygara kelal!

a: La salka datach – dumeya deyiud, ma yiud, af al gav dei bae meyayed vei bae la meyayed, kol hecha dela matze meyayed – la havu zevina zevine, hachi name kol hecha dela matzya[1] meygara – la havu zevina zevine.
Vekiddushe ishsha levet shammay nafka lehu meama haivriyya: ma ama haivriyya bifruta la mikkanya, af ishsha bifruta la mikkaddesha.
Veema palga dedinar, veema shete perutot! kevan deappikteh mipperuta – okma addinar.
Rava amar: hayeynu tama devet shammay: shello yehu benot yisrael kehefker.
Uvet hillel omrim bifruta. savar rav yosef lememar: peruta kol dehu. amar leh abbaye: veha ala katane: kamma hi peruta – echad mishshemona baissar haitalki.

Vechi tema: hane mille bedoro shel moshe, aval hacha kedachashiva lehu leinashe – veha ki ata rav dimi amar: shier rabbi simay bedoro kamma hi peruta: echad mishshemona baissar haitalki, vechi ata ravin amar: rabbi dostay verabbi yannay verabbi oshaya shiaru kamma have peruta – echad mishshishsha beissar haitalki!

Amar leh rav yosef: i hachi, hayeynu detanena: "tze vachashov kamma perutot bishne selaim – yoter mealpayim" – hasheta alpayim la havyayn, yater mealpayim kare lehu? amar lehu hahu sava: ana tenena la: "karov lealpayim". sof sof alpa vachamesh mea utelatin veshitta hu dehavyayn! kevan denafka lehu mippalga – karov lealpayim kare leh.

Gufa, ki ata rav dimi amar: shier rabbi simay bedoro kamma hi peruta – echad mishshemona baissar haitalki, vechi ata ravin amar: shiaru rabbi dostay verabbi yannay verabbi oshaya kamma hi peruta – echad mishshishsha baissar haitalki. amar leh abbaye lerav dimi: nema, at veravin biflugeta dehane tannae ka mippalgitu,

Detanya: peruta sheamru chachamim – echad mishshemona baissar haitalki, shesh maa kesef – dinar, maa – shene punedyonin, punedyon – shene issarin, issar – shene mismesim, mismes – shene kunetronkin, kunetronk – shete ferutot. nimtza, peruta – echad mishshemona baissar haitalki.

Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: shelosha haderesin lemaa, shene hanetzin lehaderes, shene shemenin lahanetz, shete ferutot leshamen, nimtza, peruta – echad mishshishsha beissar haitalki. lema demar amar ketanna kamma veravin deamar kerabban shimon ben gamliel?
Amar leh: ben didi uven ravin allibba detanna kamma, vela kashya: ha – deiyyakkur issure, ha – dezul issure. ha deiyyakkur issure – kum esrim vearba bezuza, ha dezul – kum telatin uteren bezuza.
Amar shemuel: kiddeshah bitmara, afillu omed kor temarim bedinar – mekuddeshet; chayyshinan shemma shave peruta bemaday.
Veha anan tenan: bet hillel omrim bifruta uveshave peruta! la kashya, ha bekiddushe vadday, ha bekiddushe safek.

Hahu gavra dekaddesh bizvoda deudere, yatev rav shimi bar chiyyay kammeh derav veka meayyen ba, i it ba shave peruta – in, i la – la. vei let ba shave peruta la? vehaamar shemuel: chayyshinan! la kashya, ha bekiddushe vadday, ha bekiddushe safek.

Hahu gavra dekaddesh beavna dechuchela, yatev rav chisda veka meshaer lay, i it ba shave peruta – in, vei la – la. vei let ba shave peruta la? veha amar shemuel: chayyshinan! rav chisda la savar leh dishmuel.
Amara leh immeh: veha hahu yoma dekaddesha hava ba shave peruta! amar la: lav kol keminnach deasrat la abbatra.
b: Lav hayeynu dihudit devethu derabbi chiyyay, (dahavet) [dahava] la tzaar leda, amara leh: amara li em: kabbel bich avuch kiddushe ki zuterat. amar la: lav kol keminna deimmach deasra lich illavay.
Amri leh rabbanan lerav chisda: ammay? ha ikka sahadi beidit, deyadi divhahu yoma hava bay shave peruta! hasheta miha la letanhu kamman.
Lav hayeynu derabbi chanina, deamar rabbi chanina: edeha betzad astan, veteaser?!
Abbaye verava la sevira lehu leha derav chisda. im hekellu bishvuya, dimnavvevla nafsha gabbe shabbay, naykel beeshet ish?!
Ishtear mehahi mishpacha besura, uferashu rabbanan minna. velav mishshum disvira lehu dishmuel, ella mishshum disvira lehu keabbaye verava.
Hahu gavra dekaddesh beshutita deasa beshuka, shalcha rav acha bar huna lekammeh derav yosef: kehay gavvna may? shelach leh: naggedeh kerav, veatzrech gitta kishmuel.
Derav menagged al dimkaddesh beshuka, veal dimkaddesh bevia, veal dimkaddesh bela shidduche.
Veal dimvattel gitta, veal demasar modaa aggitta, veal dimtzaar shelucha derabbanan, veal dechala shamta illaveh telatin yomin,
Veal chatna dedayayr be chamu. dedayayr – in, chalef – la?! veha hahu chatna dachalef abbava deve chamu venaggedeh rav sheshet! hahu medam havat dayyma chamateh minneh.
Nehardae amri: bechullehu, la menagged rav ella al dimkaddesh bevia bela shidduche. veikka deamri: vaafillu beshidduche name mishshum peritzuta.

Hahu gavra dekaddesh betzippeta deasa, amaru leh: veha let ba shave peruta! amar lehu: tikdosh bearba zuze deit ba. shekalta veishtika. amar rava: have shetikuta dilachar mattan maot, vechol shetikuta dilachar mattan maot, lav kelum hi.

Amar rava: mena amena la, detanya: amar lah: kinsi sela zo befikkadon, vechazar veamar lah: hitkaddeshi li bo. bishat mattan maot – mekuddeshet, leachar mattan maot, ratzta – mekuddeshet, lo ratzta – enah mekuddeshet.
May "ratzta" umay "lo ratzta"? ilema "ratzta" – deamra: "in", lo ratzta deamra: "la", mikkelal deresha,

a: Ki amra "la" name havu kiddushin? ammay, veha kaamra "la"! ella lav: "ratzta" – deamra: "in", lo ratzta – deishtika mishtako. ushema minna shetika dilachar mattan maot – velo kelum hi.

Kashu bah befum nahara mishshemeh derav huna bereh derav yehoshua: mi dame? hatam betorat pikkadon yahavinhu nihala, savra: i shadena lehu umittavri – mechayyayvna behu, hacha betorat kiddushin yahavinhu nihala, vei ita dela nicha la – (lishdinhu)!

Parech rav achay: attu kullehu neshe dina gemiri? hachi name savra: i shadena lehu umittavri mitchayyayvna beachrayutayyhu. shelacha rav acha bar rav lekammeh deravina: kehay gavvna may? shelach leh: anan la shemia lan ha derav huna bereh derav yehoshua, attun dishmia lechu – chushu la.

Hahi itteta dahava ka mezabbena vavrsheche, ata hahu gavra chataf vavrshecha minna, amara leh: have nihali! amar la: i yahevna lich mikkaddeshat li? shekalteh veishtika. veamar rav nachman: yechevla lememar: in, shekali, vedidi shekali.
Etiveh rava lerav nachman: kiddesha begazel uvechamas, uvigneva, o shechataf sela miyyadah vekiddeshah – mekuddeshet! hatam bidshaddech.

Umena temra deshane lan ben shaddech udela shaddech, detanya: amar lah: "kinsi sela zo sheani chayyayv lichi" vechazar veamar lah: "hitkaddeshi li bo", bishat mattan maot, ratzta – mekuddeshet, lo ratzta – enah mekuddeshet. leachar mattan maot, afillu ratzta – enah mekuddeshet.
May "ratzta" umay "lo ratzta"? ilema "ratzta" – deamra in, lo ratzta – deamra la, ha ishtika – havu kiddushin. venitne "mekuddeshet" setam, ki hatam!
Ella: "ratzta" – deamra "in", "lo ratzta" – deishtika, veka tane deenah mekuddeshet. may tama? yechevla lememar: in, shekali, vedidi shekali.
Veella kashya hach dekiddeshah begazel uvechamas uvigneva o shechataf sela miyyadah vekiddeshah – mekuddeshet! ella lav shema minna: ha – deshaddech, ha – dela shaddech.

Ki nach nafsheh derabbi assi, ayaylu rabbanan lenakkotinhu lishmatateh. amar lehu hahu merabbanan verabbi yaakov shemeh: hachi amar rabbi assi amar rabbi mani: keshem sheen ishsha niknet befachot mishshave peruta – kach en karka niknet befachot mishshave peruta. amaru leh: vehatanya: af al pi sheen ishsha niknet befachot mishshave peruta – karka niknet befachot mishshave peruta!
Amar lehu: ki tanya hahi – bachalifin, detanya: konin bichli, veaf al pi sheen bo shave peruta.

Hadar yatvi vekaamri, ha deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: kol sheeno yodea betiv gittin vekiddushin lo yehe lo esek immahen. amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: vekashin leolam yoter middor hammabbul, shenneemar: "alo vechachesh veratzoach veganov venaof paratzu vedamim bedamim nagau".
May mashma? kedimtargem rav yosef: moldin benin minneshe chavrehon chovin al chovin mosifin,

Uchetiv "al ken teeval haaretz veumlal kol yoshev bah bechayyat hassade uveof hashshamayim vegam dege hayyam yeasefu vegomer", veillu bedor hammabbul lo nigzera gezera al dagim shebbayyam. shenneemar: "mikkol asher becharava metu" – velo dagim shebbayyam. veillu hacha, afillu dagim shebbayyam.
Veema ad deaved lechullehu! la salka datach, dichtiv: "ki mippene ala avla haaretz".
Veema: ala lechud, vehanach lechudehon!
b: Mi ketiv "ufaratzu"? "paratzu" ketiv.
Hadur yatvi vekaamri: ha ditnan: haishsha shehevia chattatah umeta – yaviu yorshin olatah. amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: vehu shehifrishatta mechayyim. aval lo hifrishatta mechayyim – la.
Alma kasavar shibuda lav deorayyta. amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: af al gav shello hifrishatta mechayyim. alma kasavar: shibuda have deorayyta.

Veha peligi ba chada zimna, derav ushemuel deamri tarvayyhu: milva al pe – enah gova min hayyorshin velo min hallakochot. verabbi yochanan veresh lakish deamri tarvayyhu: milva al pe – gova ben min hayyorshin, ben min hallakochot.
Tzericha, dei ittemar beha – behach kaamar shemuel, mishshum dela milva ketuva battora hi, aval behach – ema mode lehu lerabbi yochanan uleresh lakish.
Vei ashmeinan beha – beha kaamar rabbi yochanan, demilva ketuva battora kichtuva bishtar damya, aval behach – ema mode leh lishmuel, tzericha.
Amar rav pappa: hilcheta, milva al pe – gove min hayyorshin, veeno gove min hallakochot. gove min hayyorshin – shibuda deorayyta, veeno gove min hallakochot – delet leh kala.
Vekona et atzmah beget uvemitat habbaal. bishlama get, dichtiv: "vechatav lah sefer keritut".
Ella mitat habbaal menalan? sevara hu: hu asra vehu sharta.
Veha arayot, deasar lehu vela share lehu! ella middeamar rachamana yevama sheen lah banim – asura, ha yesh lah banim – mutteret.
Vedilma: en lah banim – asura lealma vesharya leyavam, veyesh lah banim – lechulle alma name asura! ella, middeamar rachamana almana lechohen gadol – asura, ha lechohen hedyot sharya.
Vedilma lechohen gadol belav, lechulle alma baase? hay ase may avidteh? i deahanya mitat habbaal – tishtere ligmare, i dela ahanya mitat habbaal – tokma bemilleta kammayyta!
Allema la? appikta mimmita veokemta al ase, midde dehave appesule hammukedashim,
Demeikkara it behu meila, vaasiri begizza vaavoda. parkinhu – meila let behu, begizza vaavoda asiri.
Ella middeamar kera: "pen yamut bammilchama veish acher yikkachenna". matkef la rav shisha bereh derav idi: ema, man acher – yavam!

Amar rav ashe: shete teshuvot baddavar: chada, deyavam la ikkeri acher. veod: ketiv: "useneah haish haacharon vechatav lah sefer keritut" "o chi yamut haish haacharon", veittakkash mita legerushin – ma gerushin sharya vegomeret, af mita sharya vegomeret.
Vehayyevama niknet bevia kulei. bevia menalan? amar kera:

a: "Yevamah yavo aleha ulekachah lo leishsha". veema, lechulla milleta keishsha! la salka datach, detanya: yachol yehu kesef ushetar gomrim bah, kederech shehabbia gomeret bah? talmud lomar: "veyibbemah" – bia gomeret bah veen kesef ushetar gomrim bah.
Veema: may "veyibbemah"? dival kurcha meyabbem. im ken, lema kera: "veyibbem", may "veyibbemah"? shamat minna tarte.
Bachalitza. menalan? dichtiv: "venikra shemo beyisrael bet chalutz hannaal" – kevan shechalatz bah naal, huttera lechol yisrael.
Hay "yisrael" lehachi hu daata? hay mibbee leh lechidtane rav shemuel bar yehuda: "beyisrael" – bevet din shel yisrael, velo bevet din shel nochrim! tere "beyisrael" ketivi.

Veakkatti mibbee leh lechidtanya, amar rabbi yehuda: paam achat hayinu yoshvim lifne rabbi tarfon, uvata yevama lachlotz, veamar lanu: anu kullechem veimru: "chalutz hannaal, chalutz hannaal". hahu, mivvenikra shemo" nafka.
Uvemitat hayyavam. menalan? kal vachomer: uma eshet ish shehi bechenek – mitat habbaal mattiratah, yevamah shehi belav – lo kol shekken?
Ma leeshet ish, shekken yotza beget, tomar bezo sheenah yotza beget! ha name yotza bachalitza.
Ella: ma leeshet ish shekken osrah mattirah! amar rav ashe: ha name osrah mattirah – yavam osrah, yavam share la.

Utehe eshet ish yotza bachalitza mikkal vachomer: uma yevama sheenah yotza beget – yotza bachalitza, zo, sheyyotza beget – eno din sheyyotza bachalitza? amar kera: "sefer keritut" – sefer kortah, veen davar acher kortah.
Utehe yevama yotzet beget mikkal vachomer: uma eshet ish sheen yotza bachalitza – yotza beget, zo sheyyotza bachalitza – en din sheyyotza beget? amar kera: "kacha", vechacha" ikkuva.
Vechol hecha deikka ikkuva la darshi kal vachomer? veha yom hakkippurim dichtiv: "goral", vechukka",
Vetanya: "veasahu chattat" – haggoral ose chattat, veen hashshem ose chattat.
Sheyyachol, vahalo din hu: uma bimkom shello kiddesh haggoral – kiddesh hashshem, mekom shekkiddesh haggoral – eno din sheyyekaddesh hashshem?
Talmud lomar: "veasahu chattat" – haggoral ose chattat veen hashshem ose chattat. vetama demaateh kera, ha lav hachi darshinan kal vachomer, af al gav dichtiv beh "chukka"!
Amar kera: "lah", "lah" – velo livamah. veema "lah" lishmah!
Tere "lah" ketivi. veakkatti mibbee leh chad "lah" lishmah, veiddach "lah" – velo lah velachavertah!
Ella, amar kera: "naal" – naal in, midde acharina – la.
Vehay "naal" lehachi hu daata? hay mibbee leh lechidtanya: "naalo" – en li ella naalo, naal shel kol adam mena leh?
Talmud lomar: "naal" "naal" – ribba. im ken ma talmud lomar "naalo"? – naalo harauy lo, perat legadol sheen yachol lehallech bo, perat lekatan sheen chofe et rov raglo, perat
b: Limsuleyam sheen lo akev! im ken nichtov kera "naal", may "hannaal"? shamat minna tarte.

Mishna eved ivri nikne bechesef uvishtar, vekone atzmo beshanim, uvayyovel, uvegiron kesef. yetera alav ama haivriyya shekkona et atzmah besimanin. hannirtza, nikne birtzia, vekone et atzmo bayyovel, uvemitat haadon.
Gemara eved ivri nikne bechesef. menalan? amar kera: "mikkesef miknato" – melammed shennikne bechesef. ashkechan eved ivri hannimkar lenochri, hoil vechol kinyano bechesef,
Nimkar leyisrael menalan? amar kera: "vehofde" – melammed shemmegaraat pidyonah, veyotza.
Ashkechan ama haivriyya, hoil umikkaddesha bechesef – mikkanya bechesef, eved ivri menalan? amar kera: "ki yimmacher lecha achicha haivri o haivriyya vaavadcha shesh shanim" – makkish ivri leivriyya.
Ashkechan mecharuhu bet din, hoil venimkar beal korcho, mocher atzmo menalan?
Yalef "sachir" "sachir". hanicha leman deyalef "sachir" "sachir", ella leman dela yalef "sachir" "sachir", may ikka lememar?
Amar kera: "vechi tassig" – musaf al inyan rishon, veyilmad elyon mittachton.
Uman tanna dela yalef "sachir" "sachir"? hay tanna hu, detanya: hammocher atzmo nimkar leshesh, veyater al shesh, mecharuhu bet din – eno nimkar ella leshesh.

Hammocher atzmo eno nirtza, mecharuhu bet din – nirtza. mocher atzmo en maanikim lo, mecharuhu bet din – maanikim lo. hammocher atzmo en rabbo moser lo shifcha kenaanit, mecharuhu bet din – rabbo moser lo shifcha kenaanit.

Rabbi elazar omer: ze vaze eno nimkar ella leshesh, ze vaze nirtza, vaze vaze maanikim lo, veze vaze rabbo moser lo shifcha kenaanit. may lav beha kamippalgi, detanna kamma la yalef "sachir" "sachir", verabbi elazar yalef "sachir" "sachir"?

Amar rav tavyome mishshemeh deabbaye: dechulle alma yalef "sechir" "sachir", vehacha behay kera kamippalgi: may tama detanna kamma deamar mocher atzmo nimkar leshesh veyater al shesh? miet rachamana gabbe mecharuhu bet din: "vaavadcha shesh shanim" – ze, velo mocher atzmo.
Veiddach: "vaavadcha" – lecha, velo leyoresh.
Veiddach? "vaavadcha" acharina ketiv. veiddach? hahu leharetzaat adon hu daata.
May tama detanna kamma deamar mocher atzmo eno nirtza? middemayet rachamana gabbe mecharuhu bet din: "veratza adonav et ozno bammartzea" – ozno shello, velo ozno shel mocher atzmo.

a: Veiddach? hahi – ligzera shava hu daata. detanya, rabbi eliezer omer: minnayin lirtzia shehi beozen yamanit? neemar kan: "ozen", veneemar lehallan: "ozen". ma lehallan yamin – af kan yamin.
Veiddach? im ken lema kera "ozen", may "ozno"?
Veiddach? hahu mibbee leh: "ozno" – velo oznah. veiddach? nafka la mivveim yomar haeved" – haeved velo ama.
Veiddach? mibbee leh: ad sheyyomar keshehu eved.
Veiddach? meeved" "haeved" nafka. veiddach? "eved" "haeved" la daresh.
May tama detanna kamma deamar mocher atzmo en maanikin lo? miet rachamana gabbe mecharuhu bet din: "haanek taanik lo" – lo, velo lemocher atzmo.
Veiddach? hahu mibbee leh: lo, velo leyorshav. yorshav ammay la? "sachir" karyeh rachamana, ma sachir peullato leyorshav – af hay peullato leyorshav! ella: lo, velo levaal chovo.

Middisvira lan bealma kerabbi natan, detanya, amar rabbi natan: minnayin lannoshe bachavero mane, vachavero bachavero – minnayin shemmotziin mizze venotnin laze? talmud lomar: "venatan laasher asham lo".
Ata "lo" leappoke. veiddach? bealma name la sevira lan kerabbi natan.

May tama detanna kamma deamar mocher atzmo en rabbo moser lo shifcha kenaanit? mayet rachamana gabbe mecharuhu bet din: "im adonav yitten lo ishsha" – lo, velo lemocher atzmo. veiddach? lo – beal korcho.
Veiddach? mikki mishne sechar sachir" nafka, detanya: "ki mishne sechar sachir avadcha" – sachir eno oved ella bayyom, eved ivri oved ben bayyom uven ballayla.

Vechi taale al datecha sheeved ivri oved ben bayyom uven ballayla? vahalo kevar neemar: "ki tov lo immach" – immecha bammaachol, immecha bammishte. veamar rabbi yitzchak: mikkan sherabbo moser lo shifcha kenaanit.
Veiddach? i mehatam, hava amena hane mille middateh, aval beal kurcheh ema la, ka mashma lan.
Ella, man tanna dela yalef "sachir" "sachir"? hay tanna hu, detanya: "veshav el mishpachto vegomer" amar rabbi eliezer ben yaakov: bamma hakkatuv medabber? i bemocher atzmo – hare kevar amur!

I benirtza – hare kevar amur! ha en hakkatuv medabber ella bimcharuhu bet din shetayim veshalosh shanim lifne hayyovel, shehayyovel motzio. vei salka datach yalef "sachir" "sachir", lema li? nelaf "sachir" "sachir"!
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: leolam yalef "sachir" "sachir", veitzterich, salka datach amena, mocher atzmo hu, dela avad issura, aval mecharuhu bet din, daavad issura, ema nikneseh, ka mashma lan.
Amar mar: i benirtza – hare kevar amur. may hi? detanya: "veshavtem ish el achuzzato veish el mishpachto vegomer" bamma hakkatuv medabber? i bemocher atzmo – hare kevar amur!

I bimcharuhu bet din – hare kevar amur! ha en hakkatuv medabber ella benirtza shetayim veshalosh shanim lifne hayyovel, shehayyovel motzio. may mashma? amar rava bar shela: amar kera: "ish", ezehu davar shennoheg baish veen noheg baishsha – heve omer zo retzia.
Veitzterich lemichtav mecharuhu bet din, veitzterich lemichtav nirtza. dei ashmeinan mecharuhu bet din, mishshum dela metay zimneh, aval nirtza, dimtay zimneh, ema nikneseh.
Vei ashmeinan nirtza, mishshum daavad leh shesh, aval mecharuhu bet din, dela avad leh shesh, ema la, tzericha.
Veitzterich lemichtav "veshavtem", veitzterich lemichtav "leolam". dei ketav rachamana "leolam", hava amena leolam mammash, ketav rachamana "veshavtem".

Vei ketav rachamana "veshavtem", hava amena: hane mille hecha dela avad shesh, aval hecha daavad shesh lo yehe sofo chamur mittechillato, ma techillato shesh – af sofo name shesh, kamashma lan: "leolam" – leolamo shel yovel.
Ella man tanna dela yalef "sachir" "sachir"? rabbi hi, detanya:
b: "Veim lo yiggael beelle" rabbi omer: beelle hu nigal, veen nigal beshesh.
Sheyyachol vahalo din hu, uma mi sheeno nigal beelle – nigal beshesh, ze, shennigal beelle – eno din shennigal beshesh? talmud lomar: "beelle" – beelle hu nigal, veen nigal beshesh.
Vei salka datach yalef "sachir" "sachir", ammay kaamar "uma mi sheeno nigal beelle"? nelaf "sachir" "sachir"!
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: leolam yalef "sachir" "sachir", veshane hacha deamar kera "yigalennu" – laze, velo leacher.

Uman tanna diflig aleh derabbi? rabbi yose haggelili verabbi akiva. detanya: "lo yiggael beelle" rabbi yose haggelili omer: "beelle" – leshichrur, bishar kol adam – leshibud. rabbi akiva omer: "beelle" – leshibud, bishar kol adam – leshichrur.

May tama derabbi yose haggelili? amar kera: "im lo yiggael beelle" – ella beacher – "veyatza bishnat hayyovel". verabbi akiva omer: "im lo yiggael" – ella – "beelle", "veyatza bishnat hayyovel". verabbi yose haggelili? midde "ella beelle" ketiv?
Ella behay kera kamippalgi: "o dodo o ven dodo yigalennu" – zo geullat kerovim, "o hissiga yado" – zo geullat atzmo, "venigal" – zo geullat acherim.

Rabbi yose haggelili savar: mikra nidrash lefanav, shedi geullat kerovim aggeullat atzmo, ma geullat atzmo leshichrur – af geullat kerovim leshichrur. verabbi akiva savar: mikra nidrash leacharav, shedi geullat acherim aggeullat atzmo, ma geullat atzmo leshichrur – af geullat acherim leshichrur.
I hachi, "beelle" lema li? i lav "beelle" hava amena mikra nidrash ben lefanav ben leacharav, vehakkol leshichrur.
I hachi, hadar kusheya leducheteh. ella, bisvara kamippalgi:

Rabbi yose haggelili savar: mistabbera geullat acherim leshibud, dei amrat leshichrur, havo mimmani vela parki leh. verabbi akiva savar: mistabbera geullat kerovim leshibud, dei amrat leshichrur, kol yoma veyoma azal umezabben nafsheh.
Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: zo divre rabbi yose haggelili verabbi akiva, aval chachamim omrim: hakkol leshichrur.
Man chachamim? rabbi hi, demappek leh lehay "beelle" lidrasha acharina, umikra nidrash ben lefanav uven leacharav.
Verabbi, hay "veyatza bishnat hayyovel" may aved leh? mibbee leh lechidtanya: "veyatza bishnat hayyovel"

a: – Benochri sheyyeshno tachat yadecha, o eno ella benochri sheeno tachat yadecha? amarta, vechi ma efshar laasot lo? ha en hakkatuv medabber ella benochri sheyyeshno tachat yadecha.
Uvishtar. menalan? amar ulla: amar kera: "im acheret yikkach lo" – hikkishah hakkatuv leacheret, ma acheret mikkanya bishtar – af ama haivriyya mikkanya bishtar.

Hanicha leman deamar: shetar ama haivriyya adon kotvo, ella leman deamar: av kotvo, may ikka lememar? deittemar: shetar ama haivriyya, mi kotvo? rav huna amar: adon kotvo, rav chisda amar: av kotvo. hanicha lerav huna, ella lerav chisda may ikka lememar?
Amar rav acha bar yaakov: amar kera: "lo tetze ketzet haavadim" – aval niknet hi kekinyan avadim. umay nihu – shetar.
Veema: aval niknet hi kekinyan avadim, umay nihu – chazaka! amar kera: "vehitnachaltem otam livnechem acharechem" – otam bachazaka, velo acher bachazaka.
Veema: otam bishtar, velo acher bishtar! hachtiv "lo tetze ketzet haavadim". uma raita?

Mistabbera, shetar hava leh lerabboye, shekken motzi bevat yisrael. adderabba, chazaka hava leh lerabboye, shekken kona benichse hagger! beishut mihat la ashkechan. i baet ema: lehachi ahani "im acheret".

Verav huna, hay "lo tetze ketzet haavadim" may daresh beh? hahu mibbee leh: sheenah yotza berashe evarim keeved. verav chisda? im ken, lichtov kera: "lo tetze kaavadim", may "ketzet haavadim"? – shema minna tarte.
Vekone et atzmo beshanim. dichtiv: "shesh shanim yaavod uvashsheviit vegomer"
Bayyovel. dichtiv: "ad shenat hayyovel yaavod immach".
Begiron kesef. amar chizkiyya: deamar kera: "vehofde" – melammed shemmegaraa[400] pidyonah veyotza. tana: vekone et atzmo bechesef uveshave kesef uvishtar.

Bishlama kesef, dichtiv: "mikkesef miknato"; shave kesef name, "yashiv geullato" amar rachamana, lerabbot shave kesef kechesef; ella hay shetar hechi dame? illema dichtav leh shetara addemeh, hayeynu kesef!
Ella, shichrur – shetar lema li? lema leh beappe tere: "zil", i name beappe be dina: "zil". amar rava: zot omeret eved ivri gufo kanuy, veharav shemmachal al girono – en girono machul.

Yetera alav, ama haivriyya. amar resh lakish: ama haivriyya kona et atzmah bemitat haav mershut adon, mikkal vachomer: uma simanin sheen motziin mershut av – motziin mershut adon, mita shemmotzia mershut av – eno din shemmotzia mershut adon?
Metivi rav hoshaya: yetera alav ama haivriyya shekkona et atzmah besimanin. veim ita, nitne name mitat haav! tena veshayyayr.
May shayyayr dehay shayyayr? shayyayr mitat haadon. i mishshum mitat haadon, lav shiyyura hu, dechevan deikka name beish – la katane.
Veella nitne! tanna davar sheyyesh lo kitzva katane, davar sheen lo kitzva – la katane.
Veha simanin, deen lahem kitzva, vekatane! amar rav safra: en lahem kitzva lemala, aval yesh lahem kitzva
b: Lematta.

Detanya: ben tesha shanim shehevi shete searot – shuma, mibben tesha shanim veyom echad ad ben shetem esre shana veyom echad veodan bo – shuma, rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: siman. ben shelosh esre shana veyom echad – divre hakkol siman.
Metiv rav sheshet: rabbi shimon omer: arbaa maanikim lahem, shelosha baish, ushelosha baishsha. vei atta yachol lomar arbaa beechad, lefi sheen simanim baish, veen retzia baishsha.

Veim ita, nitne name mitat av! vechi tema hacha name tanna veshayyayr, veha arbaa katane! vechi tema tanna davar sheyyesh lo kitzva katane vedavar sheen lo kitzva la katane, veha simanin, deen lahem kitzva, vekatane!
Vechi tema hacha name kidrav safra, vehaikka mitat adon, deen lah(40) kitzva, vekatane! mitat adon name la katane.
Veella, arbaa may nihu? shanim, veyovel, veyovel shel retzia, veama haivriyya besimanim.
Hachi name mistabbera, dekatane sefa: i atta yachol lomar arbaa beechad mehem, lefi sheen simanim baish veen retzia baishsha. veim ita, beishsha miha mashkachat la arbaa, shema minna.
Metiv rav amram: veellu maanikim lahem: hayyotze beshanim, uvayyovel, uvemitat haadon, veama haivriyya besimanim. veim ita, nitne name mitat av! vechi tema tena veshayyayr, veha "ellu" katane!

Vechi tema: davar sheyyesh lo kitzva katane, davar sheen lo kitzva la katane, veha simanin, deen lahem kitzva vekatane. vechi tema hacha name kidrav safra, haikka mitat adon! teyuveta deresh lakish! teyuveta.
Veha resh lakish kal vachomer amar! kal vachomer pericha hu, mishshum deikka lemifrach: ma lesimanin – shennishtanna hagguf, tomar bemitat av – shekken lo nishtanna hagguf.
Tane chada: enek eved ivri – leatzmo, veenek ama haivriyya – leatzmah. vetanya iddach: enek ama haivriyya umetziatah – leaviha, veen lerabba ella sechar battala bilvad.
May lav, ha – denafka besimanim, veha – denafka la bemitat av!
La, idi veidi denafka la besimanin, vela kashya: ha deiteh leav, ha deleteh leav.
Bishlama enek ama haivriyya leatzmah – lemaote achin, detanya: "vehitnachaltem otam livnechem acharechem" – otam livnechem, velo benotechem livnechem. mikkan sheen adam morish zechut bitto livno.
Ella enek eved ivri leatzmo – peshita! ella leman? amar rav yosef: yod keret ka chazena hacha.
Abbaye amar: hachi amar rav sheshet: ha manni – tutay hu. detanya, tutay omer: "lo", velo levaal chovo.

Gufa, ellu maanikim lahem: hayyotze beshanim, uvayyovel, uvemitat adon, veama haivriyya besimanin. aval boreach veyotze begiron kesef – en maanikim lo. rabbi meir omer: boreach – en maanikin lo, veyotze begiron kesef – maanikim lo.
Rabbi shimon omer: arbaa maanikim lahem, shelosha baish ushelosha baishsha, vei atta yachol lomar arbaa beechad mehen lefi sheen simanin baish uretzia baishsha.

Mena hane mille? detanu rabbanan: yachol lo yehu maanikim ella layyotze beshesh, minnayin lerabbot yotze bayyovel uvemitat haadon veama haivriyya besimanin? talmud lomar: "teshallechennu" "vechi teshallechennu".

Yachol sheani merabbe boreach veyotze begiron kesef? talmud lomar: "vechi teshallechennu chofshi meimmach" – mi sheshshillucho meimmach, yatza boreach veyotze begiron kesef sheen shillucho meimmach. rabbi meir omer: boreach en maanikin lo, deen shillucho meimmach, aval yotze begiron kesef, sheshshillucho meimmach.
Boreach – hashelama bae! detanya: minnayin levoreach shechayyayv lehashelim – talmud lomar: "shesh shanim yaavod".

a: Yachol afillu chala? – talmud lomar: "uvashsheviit yetze"?
Amar rav sheshet: hacha bemay askinan, kegon shebbarach ufaga bo yovel. mahu detema: hoil veappek leh yovel, "shillucho meimmach" karenan beh, vela nikneseh, venaanek leh, ka mashma lan.

Amar mar: yachol afillu chala – talmud lomar: "uvashsheviit yetze". afillu chala kol shesh? vehatanya: chala shalosh veavad shalosh – eno chayyayv lehashelim, chala kol shesh – chayyayv lehashelim! amar rav sheshet: beose maase machat.

Ha gufa kashya – amrat: chala shalosh veavad shalosh – en chayyayv lehashelim. ha arba – chayyayv lehashelim. ema sefa: chala kol shesh – chayyayv lehashelim. ha arba – en chayyayv lehashelim! hachi kaamar: chala arba, naasa kemi shechala kol shesh vechayyayv lehashelim.

Tanu rabbanan: kamma maanikim lo? chamesh selaim mikkol min vamin, shehen chamesh esre selaim, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: sheloshim, kishloshim shel eved. rabbi shimon omer: chamishshim, kachamishshim shebbaarachin.

Amar mar: chamesh selaim mikkol min vamin, shehem chamesh esre selaim, divre rabbi meir. verabbi meir, minyana ata leashmoinan? ha ka mashma lan: mivtzar hu dela (mevatztzar) [livtzar] leh mehay minyana, vei batzar leh mechad mina vetafe leh mechad mina – let lan ba.
May tama derabbi meir? yalef "rekam" "rekam" mibbechor. ma lehallan chamesh selaim – af kan chamesh selaim.
Veema, chamesh selaim mikkullehu! i ketiv "rekam" levassof, kidkaamrat. hasheta dichtiv "rekam" beresha, shedi "rekam" atztzon", "rekam" aggoren", "rekam" ayyekev".
Venelaf "rekam" "rekam" meolat reiyya! amar kera: "asher berachcha Adonai elohecha".
Rabbi yehuda omer: sheloshim kishloshim shel eved. may tama derabbi yehuda? yalef "netina" "netina" meeved. ma lehallan sheloshim – af kan sheloshim.
Venelaf "netina" "netina" mearachin, ma lehallan chamishshim – af kan chamishshim!
Chada, detafasta merubbe lo tafasta, tafasta muat tafasta. veod, eved meeved hava leh lemelaf.

Rabbi shimon omer: chamishshim kachamishshim shebbaarachin. may tameh derabbi shimon? gamar "netina" "netina" mearachin, ma lehallan chamishshim – af kan chamishshim. veema: kappachut shebbaarachin! "asher berachcha Adonai elohecha" ketiv.
Venelaf "netina" "netina" meeved, ma lehallan sheloshim – af kan sheloshim; chada, detafasta merubbe lo tafasta, veod, eved meeved hava leh lemelaf! rabbi shimon "micha" "micha" gamar.
Bishlama lerabbi meir, hayeynu dichtiv tzon goren vayekev. ella lerabbi yehuda verabbi shimon hay tzon goren vayekev lema li?

Hay mibbee leh lechidtanya: yachol lo yehu maanikin ella mitztzon goren vayekev, minnayin lerabbot kol davar – talmud lomar: "asher berachcha Adonai elohecha". im ken ma talmud lomar tzon goren vayekev? lomar lach: ma tzon goren vayekev meyuchadim, sheyyeshnan bichlal beracha – af kol sheyyeshnan bichlal beracha, yatzu kesafim, divre rabbi shimon. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: yatzu peradot.
Verabbi shimon? peradot mashbechan begufayyhu. verabbi eliezer ben yaakov? kesafim aved behu iska.

Utzericha, dei ketav rachamana tzon, hava amena baale chayyim – in, giddule karka – la, ketav rachamana goren. vei ketav goren, hava amena: giddule karka – in, baale chayyim – la, ketav rachamana tzon. yekev lema li?
b: Lemar – lemaote kesafim, lemar – lemaote peradot.

Tanu rabbanan: "asher berachcha Adonai elohecha", yachol nitbarech bayit biglalo – maanikim lo, lo nitbarech bayit biglalo – en maanikim lo, talmud lomar: "haanek taanik" – mikkol makom. im ken, ma talmud lomar "asher berachcha" – hakkol lefi beracha ten lo.

Rabbi elazar ben azarya omer: devarim kichtavan. nitbarech bayit biglalo – maanikim lo, lo nitbarech bayit biglalo – en maanikim lo. im ken ma talmud lomar: "haanek taanik"? dibbera tora chilshon bene adam.

Tanu rabbanan: eved ivri oved et habben, veeno oved et habbat. ama ivriyya enah ovedet lo et habben velo et habbat. hannirtza vehannimkar lenochri eno oved lo et habben velo et habbat. amar mar: eved ivri oved et habben, veeno oved et habbat. menahane mille?

Detanu rabbanan: "vaavadcha shesh shanim" – lecha velo layyoresh. atta omer: lecha velo layyoresh, o eno ella: lecha velo labben? keshehu omer: shesh shanim yaavod", hare labben amur, ha ma ani mekayyem: "vaavadcha shesh shanim" lecha – velo layyoresh.
Ma raita lerabbot et habben, ulehotzi et haach? merabbe ani et habben – shekken kam tachat aviv liida velisde achuzza.
Adderabba, merabbe ani et haach shekken kam tachat achiv leyibbum! kelum yesh yibbum ella bemakom sheen ben? ha yesh ben – en yibbum.
Ella tama deikka ha pircha, ha lav hachi ach adif? vetippok li dehacha tarte, vehacha chada!
Sede achuzza name, mehay pircha hu deka nafka leh letanna: kelum yesh yibbum ella bemakom sheen ben?

Ama haivriyya enah ovedet lo et habben velo et habbat. menahane mille? amar rabbi peda: deamar kera "veaf laamatcha taase ken" – hikkishah hakkatuv lannirtza, ma nirtza eno oved lo et habben velo et habbat – af ama haivriyya enah ovedet lo et habben velo et habbat. vehay "laamatcha taase ken" lehachi hu daata? ha mibbee leh lechidtanya: "veaf laamatcha taase ken" – leheenek.
Atta omer leheenek, o eno ella lirtzia? keshehu omer "veim amor yomar haeved" – "[haeved]" velo ama haivriyya. (hare retzia amur),
Ha ma ani mekayyem "veaf laamatcha taase ken" – leheenek! im ken nichtov kera: "laamatcha ken", may "taase"? shamat minna tarte.

Hannirtza vehannimkar lenochri eno oved lo et habben velo et habbat. nirtza? dichtiv: "veratza adonav et ozno bammartzea vaavado leolam" – velo et habben veet habbat. nimkar lenochri minnayin? amar chizkiyya: amar kera: "vechishshav im konehu" – velo im yorshe konehu.
Amar rava: devar tora nochri yoresh et aviv, shenneemar: "vechishshav im konehu" – velo im yorshe konehu. mikkelal deit leh yorshim. ger et hannochri – eno middivre tora, ella middivre sofrim.
Ditnan: ger venochri sheyyarshu et avihem nochri, ger yachol lomar lenochri tol atta avoda zara vaani maot, tol atta yayin nesech vaani perot. mishshebbau lirshut ger – asur.
Vei salka datach deorayyta, ki lo vau lirshuto name – ki shakel chillufe avoda zara hu deka shakel!
Ella: midderabbanan, gezera hu daavud rabbanan shemma yachzor lesoro. tanya name hachi: bamme devarim amurim – kesheyyarshu, aval keshennishtattefu – asur.

Nochri et hagger, veger et hagger – eno lo middivre tora velo middivre sofrim. ditnan: lava maot min hagger shennitgayyeyru banav immo – lo yachazir levanav. veim hechezir – en ruach chachamim nocha hemennu.
Vehatanya ruach chachamim nocha hemennu! la kashya, kan shehorato veledato shello bikdushsha,

a: Vechan shehorato shello bikdushsha, veledato bikdushsha.

Rav chiyyay bar avin amar rabbi yochanan: nochri yoresh et aviv devar tora, dichtiv: "ki yerushsha leesav natatti et har seir". vedilma yisrael meshummad shane? ella mehacha: "ki livne lot natatti et ar yerushsha".
Verav chiyyay bar avin, may tama la amar kerava? mi ketiv "vechishshav im konehu velo im yorshe konehu"?
Verava, may tama la amar kerav chiyyay bar avin? mishshum kevodo deavraham shane.

Tanu rabbanan: yesh baivri sheen baivriyya, veyesh baivriyya sheen baivri. yesh baivri shehu yotze beshanim, uvayyovel, uvemitat haadon – ma sheen ken baivriyya, veyesh baivriyya, shehare ivriyya yotza besimanin veenah nimkeret venishnet, umafdin otah, beal korcho, ma sheen ken baivri.
Amar mar: yesh baivri sheen baivriyya. ureminhi: yetera alav ama haivriyya, shekkona atzmah besimanin! amar rav sheshet: kegon sheyyeada.
Yeada, peshita! gitta baaya! mahu detema la (livtela) [livtelan] hilchata minna, ka mashma lan. i hachi, ammay yotza besimanin? hachi kaamar: im lo yeada, yotza af besimanin.

Veenah nimkeret venishnet. mikkelal deeved ivri nimkar venishne? vehatanya: "bignevato" – velo bichfelo. "bignevato" – velo bizmamo. "bignevato" – kevan shennimkar paam achat shuv i atta rashshay lemochro.
Amar rava: la kashya, kan bigneva achat, kan bishte genevot.
Amar leh abbaye: "bignevato" – tuva mashma! ella amar abbaye: la kashya, kan beadam echad, kan bishne bene adam.

Tanu rabbanan: genevo elef, veshave chamesh meot – nimkar vechozer venimkar. genevo chamesh meot, veshave elef – eno nimkar kelal. rabbi eliezer omer: im haya genevo keneged mimkaro – nimkar, veim lav – eno nimkar.

Amar rava: beha zechanhu rabbi eliezer lerabbanan, demay shena genevo chamesh meot veshave elef deen nimkar, denimkar kullo amar rachamana, velo chetzyo, hachi name: nimkar bignevato amar rachamana velo nimkar bachatzi genevato.
Umafdin otah beal korcho. sevar rava lememar beal kurcheh deadon. amar leh abbaye: may nihu – dechatevna leh shetara addemeha? ammay? naket marganita bideh, yahevna leh chaspa?
Ella amar abbaye: beal kurcheh deav, mishshum pegam mishpacha. i hachi, eved ivri name, nichpinhu livne mishpacha mishshum pegam mishpacha! hadar azel umezabben nafsheh.

Hacha name hadar azel umezabben la! ha katane: enah nimkeret venishnet. umanni – rabbi shimon hi. detanya: mocher adam et bitto leishut veshone, leshifchut veshone, leishut achar shifchut, aval lo leshifchut achar ishut. rabbi shimon omer: keshem sheen adam mocher et bitto leshifchut achar ishut kach en adam mocher et bitto leshifchut achar shifchut.
Uviflugeta dehane tannae detanya: "bevigdo bah" –
b: Kevan shepperas tallito aleha, shuv en rashshay lemochrah, divre rabbi akiva. rabbi eliezer omer: "bevigdo bah" – kevan shebbagad bah, shuv en rashshay lemochrah.
Bemay kamippalgi? rabbi eliezer savar: yesh em lammasoret, verabbi akiva savar: yesh em lammikra, verabbi shimon savar: yesh em lammikra velammasoret.
Bae rabba bar avu: yiud nissuin ose, o erusin ose? nafka minna leyorshah, velitamme lah, ulehafer nedareha. may?

Ta shema: "bevigdo bah" – kevan shepperas tallito aleha shuv eno rashshay lemochrah. zabbone hu dela mezabben la, ha yaode meyayed la, vei amrat nissuin ose, kevan denisset shuv en leaviha reshut bah! ella lav shema minna erusin ose.
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: hacha bekiddushin dealma kae. vehachi kaamar: kevan shemmesarah aviha lemi shennitchayyev bisherah kesutah veonatah – shuv en yachol lemochrah.
Ta shema: en mochrah likrovim. mishshum rabbi eliezer amru: mochrah likrovim. veshavin shemmochrah almana lechohen gadol, gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedyot.
Hay almana hechi dame? illema dekaddish nafsha, almana kare la? veella dekaddesha aviha. mi matze mezabben la? veha en adam mocher et bitto leshifchut achar ishut.

Veamar rav amram amar rabbi yitzchak: hacha bekiddushe yiud, veallibba derabbi yose berabbi yehuda deamar: maot harishonot lav lekiddushin nittenu. vei amrat nissuin ose, kevan shennisset shuv en leaviha reshut bah!

Veella may, erusin ose? – veshavin shemmochrah?! ha en adam mocher et bitto leshifchut achar ishut! ella may it lach lememar: shane erusin dida meerusin deaviha? – afillu tema nissuin ose, shane nissuin dida minnissuin deaviha.
Hay may? bishlama erusin meerusin shane, ella nissuin minnissuin,

a: Mi shane?

Ulerav nachman bar yitzchak deamar: afillu lerabbi yose berabbi yehuda maot harishonot lekiddushin nittenu, bemay mokem la? mokem la kerabbi eliezer deamar: leshifchut achar shifchut hu dela matze mezabben la, aval leshifchut achar ishut – matze mezabben la.
Bae resh lakish: mahu shemmeyayed adam livno katan? "beno" amar rachamana, beno kol dehu, o dilma beno dumeya dideh, ma hu gadol – af beno gadol?
Amar rabbi zera: ta shema: "ish" – perat lekatan. "asher yinaf et eshet ish" – perat leeshet katan. vei amrat meyayed, im ken matzinu ishut lekatan.
Veella may, eno meyayed? ammay ka memaet leh kera? tifshot minna dimyayed. amar rav ashe: hacha beyavam ben tesha shanim veyom echad habba al yevimto askinan,
Demiddeorayyta chazya leh, mahu detema: kevan demiddeorayyta chazya leh uviato bia, habba aleha mitchayyev beeshet ish, ka mashma lan.
May have ala? ta shema, amar rabbi ayyvu amar rabbi yannay: en yiud ella begadol, en yiud ella middaat. tarte? "ma taam" kaamar. ma taam en yiud ella begadol – lefi sheen yiud ella middaat.
Veibbaet ema: may middaat – middaat dida. detane abbaye bereh derabbi avahu: "asher lo yeadah" – melammed shetztzarich leyaadah.

Hu tane la, vehu amar la: bekiddushe yiud, veallibba derabbi yose berabbi yehuda deamar: maot harishonot lav lekiddushin nittenu. rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: afillu tema lekiddushin nittenu, shane hacha deamar rachamana "yeadah".
May rabbi yose berabbi yehuda? detanya: "yeadah, vehefdah" – tzarich sheyyehe shehut bayyom kede fediyyay.
Mikkan amar rabbi yose berabbi yehuda: im yesh shehut bayyom kede laasot immo shave peruta – mekuddeshet, veim lav – enah mekuddeshet. alma kasavar: maot harishonot – lav lekiddushin nittenu.
Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: afillu tema lekiddushin nittenu, shane hacha deamar rachamana "vehefdah".
Amar rava amar rav nachman: omer adam levitto ketanna "tzei vekabbeli kiddushayich", midderabbi yose berabbi yehuda.
Lav amar rabbi yose berabbi yehuda maot harishonot lav lekiddushin nittenu, vechi meshayyayr ba shave peruta – havu kiddushe, hacha name la shena.

Veamar rava amar rav nachman: hamekaddesh bemilva sheyyesh aleha mashkon – mekuddeshet, midderabbi yose berabbi yehuda. lav amar rabbi yose berabbi yehuda maot harishonot lav lekiddushin nittenu, hay halevaa hi, vehi gufa mashkon hi,
b: Vechi meshayyayr ba shave peruta umeyayed – havu kiddushin, hacha name la shena.

Tanu rabbanan: ketzad mitzvat yiud? omer lah bifne shenayim "hare at mekuddeshet li", "hare at meoreset li" afillu besof shesh, vaafillu samuch lishkiat hachamma. venoheg bah minhag ishut veeno noheg bah minhag shifchut. rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: im yesh shehut beyom kede laasot immo shave peruta – mekuddeshet, veim lav – enah mekuddeshet.
Mashal leomer leishsha "hitkaddeshi li meachshav leachar sheloshim yom" uva acher vekiddeshah betoch sheloshim yom – shemmekuddeshet larishon. mashal leman?
Ilema mashal lerabbi yose berabbi yehuda – ha im yesh shehut beyom kede laasot immo shave peruta – mekuddeshet, veim lav – lo!
Amar rav acha bereh derava: mashal lerabbanan. peshita!
Mahu detema, ha la amar leh "meachshav", ka mashma lan.
Tanya iddach: hammocher et bitto, vehalach vekiddeshah leacher – sichek baadon, umekuddeshet lashsheni, divre rabbi yose berabbi yehuda. vachachamim omrim: im ratza leyayed – meyayed.
Mashal laomer leishsha "hare at mekuddeshet li leachar sheloshim yom" uva acher vekiddeshah betoch sheloshim yom – shemmekuddeshet lashsheni. mashal leman?
Illema lerabbanan, haamri rabbanan: im ratza leyayed – meyayed!
Ella amar rav acha bereh derava: mashal lerabbi yose berabbi yehuda. peshita!
Mahu detema, ha la amar la "leachar sheloshim yom", ka mashma lan.

Tanya iddach: hammocher et bitto, ufasak al menat shello leyayed – nitkayyem hattenay, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: im ratza leyayed – meyayed, mippene shehitna al ma shekkatuv battora, vechol hammatne al ma shekkatuv battora – tenao batel.

Ulerabbi meir tenao kayyaym? vehatanya: haomer leishsha "hare at mekuddeshet li al menat sheen lecha alay sheer kesut veona" – hare zo mekuddeshet, utenao batel, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: bedavar shebbemamon – tenao kayyaym.
Amar chizkiyya: shane hacha, deamar kera "leama" – peamim sheeno mochrah ella leama bilvad.
Verabbanan, hay "leama" may avdi leh? hay mibbee lehu lechidtanya: "leama" – melammed shemmochrah lifsulim.

Vahalo din hu: im mekaddeshah lifsulim, lo yimkerenna lifsulim? ma limkaddeshah lifsulim, shekken adam mekaddesh et bitto keshehi naara, yimkerenna lifsulim, sheen adam mocher et bitto keshehi naara? talmud lomar: "leama" – melammed shemmochrah lifsulin.
Rabbi eliezer omer: im lelammed shemmochrah lifsulin, hare kevar neemar "im raa beene adoneha" – sheraa benissueha. ma talmud lomar "leama"? melammed shemmochrah

a: Likrovim.

Vahalo din hu: im mochrah lifsulin, lo yimkerenna likrovim? ma lemochrah lifsulin, sheim ratza leyayed – meyayed, yimkerenna likrovim, sheim ratza leyayed – eno meyayed? amar kera "leama" – melammed shemmochrah likrovim.
