Verabbi meir? lifsulin, nafka leh mehecha denafka leh lerabbi eliezer. bikrovim, savar la kerabbanan deamri en mochrah likrovim.
Tane chada: mochrah leaviv, veen mochrah livno. vetanya iddach: en mochrah lo leaviv velo livno. bishlama eno mochrah lo leaviv velo livno – kerabbanan. ella mochrah leaviv veen mochrah livno, keman?
La kerabbanan vela kerabbi eliezer! leolam kerabbanan, modu rabbanan hecha deikka tzad yiud.

Tanu rabbanan: "im begappo yavo begappo yetze" – begufo nichnas begufo yetze. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: yechidi nichnas yechidi yetze. may begufo nichnas begufo yetze? amar rava: lomar sheeno yotze berashe evarim keeved. amar leh abbaye: hahu – millo tetze ketzet haavadim" nafka.
I mehatam, hava amena: nittev leh deme eneh venippok, ka mashma lan.

Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: yechidi nichnas yechidi yetze. may yechidi yetze? amar rav nachman bar yitzchak hachi kaamar: yesh lo ishsha uvanim – rabbo moser lo shifcha kenaanit, en lo ishsha uvanim – en rabbo moser lo shifcha kenaanit.
Tanu rabbanan: nimkar bemane, vehishbiach veamad al matayim, minnayin sheen mechashshevin lo, ella mane – shenneemar: "mikkesef miknato".
Nimkar bematayim vehichsif veamad al mane, minnayin sheen mechashshevin lo ella mane – talmud lomar: "kefi shanav".
En li ella eved hannimkar lenochri, hoil venigal bikrovim – yado al hattachtona.
Nimkar leyisrael menalan? talmud lomar: "sachir" "sachir" ligzera shava.

Amar abbaye: hareni keven azzay beshuke teverya. amar leh hahu merabbanan leabbaye: mikkedi hane kerae ikka lemidreshinhu lekulla veikka lemidreshinhu lechumera. may chazet (dedarshinhu) [lemidreshinhu] lekulla? nidreshinhu lechumera!
La salka datach, middeakkel rachamana legabbeh. detanya: "ki tov lo immach" – immecha bammaachol veimmecha bammishte,

Shello tehe atta ochel pat nekiyya vehu ochel pat kibbar, atta shote yayin yashan vehu shote yayin chadash, atta yashen al gabbe mochim vehu yashen al gabbe hatteven. mikkan amru: kol hakkone eved ivri kekone adon leatzmo.

Veema: hane mille leinyan achila ushetiyya, ki hechi dela litztaar leh, ha leinyan pidyon nachmir aleh. midderabbi yose berabbi chanina. detanya: rabbi yose berabbi chanina omer: bo uree kamma kashe avakah shel sheviit:

Adam nose venoten beferot sheviit – lesof mocher et mittaltelav, shenneemar: "bishnat hayyovel tashuvu ish el achuzzato", usemich leh: "vechi timkeru mimkar laamitecha o kano miyyad amitecha" – davar hannikne miyyad leyad.
Lo hirgish – lesof mocher et sedotav, shenneemar: "ki yamuch achicha umachar meachuzzato". lo bat leyado ad shemmocher et beto, shenneemar: "ki yimkor bet moshav ir choma".

May shena hatam deamar "lo hirgish" umay shena hacha deamar "lo bat leyado"? kidrav huna, deamar rav huna: kevan sheavar adam avera veshana bah – huttera lo. huttera lo salka datach? ella, naaset lo kehetter.

Lo bat leyado ad shemmocher et bitto, shenneemar: "vechi yimkor ish et bitto leama", veaf al gav devitto la ketiva behay inyana, ha ka mashma lan: nizabben inash beratte vela nezif beribbita. may tama – beratte megara venafka veha mosfa veazla.

Lo bat leyado ad shellove beribbit, shenneemar: "vechi yamuch achicha umata yado immach", usemich leh: "al tikkach meitto vegomer". lo bat leyado ad shemmocher et atzmo, shenneemar: "vechi yamuch achicha venimkar lach".
Lo lecha ella leger, shenneemar: "leger", velo leger tzedek ella leger toshav shenneemar: "ger toshav". "mishpachat ger" – ze nochri. keshehu omer: "leeker"
b: – Ze hannimkar laavoda zara atzmah.

Amar leh: hatam, ha ahdereh kera, detane deve rabbi yishmael: hoil vehalach ze venaasa komer laavoda zara, ema: lidche even achar hannofel – talmud lomar: "achare nimkar geulla tihye lo echad meechav yigalennu".
Veema: "geulla tihye lo" – ki hechi dela littamma ben hannochrim, ha leinyan pidyon nachmir aleh, midderabbi yose berabbi chanina!

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: tere kerae ketivi. ketiv: "im od rabbot bashshanim" uchetiv: "veim meat nishar bashshanim". vechi yesh shanim merubbot veyesh shanim muatot? ella, nitrabba kaspo – "mikkesef miknato", nitmaet kaspo – "kefi shanav".
Veema hachi kaamar: hecha daavad tere ufush leh arba – nittev leh arba "mikkesef miknato", avad arba ufusho leh tarte – nittev tarte "kefi shanav"?

Im ken, nichtov kera: "im od rabbot shanim", "im meat nishar shanim", may "bashshanim" – nitrabba kaspo bashshanim, "mikkesef miknato" – nitmaet kaspo bashshanim "kefi shanav". amar rav yosef: darshinhu rav nachman bar yitzchak lehane kerae kesinay.
(Siman: eved, bayit, chatzain, bayit eved, kerovim). bea minneh rav huna bar chinnana merav sheshet: eved ivri hannimkar lenochri, nigal lachatzain, o eno nigal lachatzain?
"Geullato" "geullato" missede achuzza gamar: ma sede achuzza eno nigal lachatzain – af hay name eno nigal lachatzain, o dilma lekulla amrinan, lechumera la amrinan?
Amar leh: lav amrat hatam: "nimkar" – kullo velo chetzyo, hachi name, "nigal" – kullo velo chetzyo.

Amar abbaye: im timtze lomar nigal lachatzain, mashkachat la lekulla ulechumera. lekulla: zavneh bima, yehav leh chamshin, palga dedame, veashbach vekam al matan, i amrat nigal lachatzain – yahev leh mea venafek, vei amrat en nigal lachatzain – yahev leh mea vechamshin venafek.
Vehaamrat nitrabba kaspo – "mikkesef miknato"! kegon deokir vezal veokir.

Mashkachat la lechumera: zavneh bematan, yehayv mea, palge didme, veikkesif vekam al mea, i amrat nigal lachatzain – yahev leh chamshin venafek, vei amrat en nigal lachatzain – hanach mea pikkadon ninhu gabbeh, yahev lehu nihaleh venafek.

Bea minneh rav huna bar chinnana merav sheshet: hammocher bayit bevatte are choma, nigal lachatzain, o eno nigal lachatzain? "geullato" "geullato" missede achuzza gamar: ma sede achuzza enah nigelet lachatzain – af hay name eno nigal lachatzain,
O dilma: hecha degalli – galli, hecha dela galli – la galli?
Amar leh: mimmidrasho shel rabbi shimon nishma, shellove vegoel vegoel lachatzain, detanya: "im gaol yigal" – melammed shellove vegoel vegoel lachatzain.
Amar rabbi shimon: ma taam, lefi shemmatzinu bemocher sede achuzza sheyyippa kocho, sheim higgia yovel velo nigala – chozeret livaleha bayyovel, hora kocho – sheeno love vegoel vegoel lachatzain.
Makdish, shehora kocho, sheim higgia yovel velo nigala – yotza lechohanim bayyovel, yippa kocho – shellove vegoel vegoel lachatzain.
Hay mocher bayit bevatte are choma name, hoil vehora kocho, sheim mala lo shana temima velo nigala nechlat – yippa kocho, shellove vegoel vegoel lachatzain.
Etiveh: "im gaol yigal" – melammed shellove vegoel vegoel lachatzain.

Sheyyachol, vahalo din hu: uma mocher sede achuzza sheyyippa kocho, sheim higgia yovel velo nigala chozeret livaleha bayyovel – hora kocho, sheen love vegoel vegoel lachatzain, makdish, shehora kocho, sheim higgia yovel velo nigala yotza lechohanim bayyovel – eno din shehora kocho sheen love vegoel vegoel lachatzain?
Ma lemocher sede achuzza, shekken hora kocho liggael miyyad, tomar bemakdish sheyyippa kocho liggael miyyad.
Mocher bayit bevatte are choma yochiach, sheyyippa kocho liggael miyyad veen love vegoel vegoel lachatzain! la kashya:

a: Ha rabbanan, ha rabbi shimon.
Tane chada: love vegoel vegoel lachatzain, vetanya iddach: en love vegoel vegoel lachatzain. la kashya, ha rabbanan, ha rabbi shimon.
(Siman: charash chavash zeman)
Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: ikka lemifrach: ma lemocher bayit bevatte are choma – shekken hora kocho liggael leolam, tomar bemakdish – sheyyippa kocho liggael leolam!

Amar leh rav acha sava lerav ashe: mishshum deikka lememar nehdar dina, tete bema hatztzad: mocher sede achuzza yochiach, sheyyippa kocho liggael leolam veen love vegoel vegoel lachatzain. ma lemocher sede achuzza, shekken hora kocho liggael miyyad. mocher bayit bevatte are choma yochiach.
Vechazar haddin, lo rei ze kiri ze, hatztzad hashshave shebbahen – shennigalin, veen love vegoel vegoel lachatzain, af ani avi makdish – shennigal, veen love vegoel vegoel lachatzain.

Amar leh mar zutera bereh derav mari leravina: ikka lemifrach: ma lehatztzad hashshave shebbahen – shekken hora kocham liggael beshana sheniyya, tomar bemakdish sheyyippa kocho liggael beshana sheniyya!
Amar leh ravina: mishshum deikka lememar: eved ivri hannimkar lenochri yochiach, sheyyippa kocho liggael beshana sheniyya veen love vegoel vegoel lachatzain.

Bea minneh rav huna bar chinnana merav sheshet: hammocher bayit bevatte are choma, nigal likrovim o en nigal likrovim? "geullato" "geullato" missede achuzza gamar: ma sede achuzza enah nigelet lachatzain venigelet likrovim – af hay name en nigal lachatzain venigal likrovim.
O dilma: ki ketiva "geulla" – bachatzain hu dichtiva[1], bikrovim la ketiva[1]? amar leh: eno nigal.
Etiveh: "bechol geulla tittenu" – lerabbot battim veeved ivri. may lav batte are choma? la, batte chatzerim.
Batte chatzerim behedya ketiv behu: "al sede haaretz yechashev"! hahu lekovo chova, veallibba derabbi eliezer.

Detanya: "vegaal et mimkar achiv" – reshut. atta omer reshut, o eno ella chova? talmud lomar: "veish ki lo yihye lo goel" – vechi yesh adam beyisrael sheen lo goalim? ella ze sheyyesh lo veeno rotze likkach, sheharshut beyado, divre rabbi yehoshua.
Rabbi eliezer omer: "vegaal et mimkar achiv" – chova. atta omer chova o eno ella reshut? talmud lomar: "bechol... geulla tittenu" – hakkatuv kevao chova.

Amri leh rabbanan lerav ashe, veamri la ravina lerav ashe: bishlama leman deamar lerabbot batte are choma – hayeynu dichtiv "bechol", ella leman deamar lerabbot batte chatzerim – may "bechol"? kashya.

Etiveh abbaye: ma talmud lomar: "yigalennu" "yigalennu" "yigalennu" shalosh peamim? lerabbot kol haggeullot shennigalot kasseder hazze. may lav batte are choma, veeved ivri? la, batte chatzerim usede achuzza.
Batte chatzerim usede achuzza behedya ketiv: "al sede haaretz yechashev"! kidamar rav nachman bar yitzchak: lekarov karov kodem, hachi name lekarov karov kodem.

Hecha ittemar derav nachman bar yitzchak? aha, deibbaya lehu: eved ivri hannimkar leyisrael nigal likrovim o eno nigal likrovim? allibba derabbi la tibbee lach, deamar: mi sheeno nigal beelle – nigal beshesh, alma la mipperek.
Ki tibbee lach, allibba derabbanan may? yalfinan "sachir" "sachir", vela darshi "yigalennu", o dilma "yigalennu" – laze velo leacher?
Ta shema: "bechol... geulla tittenu" – lerabbot battim veeved ivri. may lav batte are choma veeved ivri hannimkar leyisrael? la, eved ivri hannimkar lenochri.
Eved ivri hannimkar lenochri behedya ketiv beh: "o dodo o ven dodo yigalennu"!
b: Hahu lekovo chova, vaafillu lerabbi yehoshua.

Ta shema: ma talmud lomar "yigalennu" "yigalennu" "yigalennu" shalosh peamim? lerabbot kol haggeullot shennigalot kasseder hazze. may lav batte are choma veeved ivri hannimkar leyisrael? la, batte chatzerim usede achuzza. batte chatzerim behedya ketiv behu: "al sede haaretz yechashev"! amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: lekarov karov kodem.
Vehannirtza nikne birtzia. dichtiv: "veratza adonav et ozno bammartzea vegomer"
Vekone et atzmo bayyovel uvemitat haadon. dichtiv: "vaavado" – velo et habben velo et habbat. "leolam" – leolamo shel yovel.

Tanu rabbanan: "martzea" – en li ella martzea, minnayin lerabbot hassol vehassira vehammachat vehammakdeach vehammachtev? talmud lomar: "velakachta" – lerabbot kol davar shennikkach bayyad, divre rabbi yose berabbi yehuda.
Rabbi omer: ma martzea meyuchad shel mattechet – af kol shel mattechet. davar acher: "hammartzea" – lehavi hammartzea haggadol.

Amar rabbi elazar: yudan beribbi haya doresh: keshehen rotzim en rotzim ella bammilta. vachachamim omrim: en eved ivri kohen nirtza, mippene shennaase baal mum. veim tomar: bemilleta hem rotzim – heach eved ivri kohen yease baal mum? ha en nirtza ella begova shel ozen. bemay kamippalgi?

Derabbi daresh kelale uferate: "velakachta" – kalal. "martzea" – parat. "beozno uvaddelet" – chazar vechalal. kelal uferat uchelal, i atta dan ella keen happerat. ma happerat meforash shel mattechet, af kol shel mattechet.
Rabbi yose daresh ribbuye umiute: "velakachta" – ribba. "martzea" – miet. "beozno uvaddelet" – chazar veribba. ribba umiet veribba, ribba hakkol.
May rabbi – rabbi kol mille, may mayet – mayet sam.
Amar mar: "hammartzea" – lehavi martzea haggadol. may mashma? kidamar rava: "hayyarech" – hameyummenet shebbayyarech, hacha name: "hammartzea" – meyuchad shebbammartzein.

Amar rabbi elazar, yudan beribbi haya doresh: keshehen rotzin, en rotzin ella bemilta, vachachamim omrim: en eved ivri kohen nirtza mippene shennaase baal mum. veyease baal mum! amar rabba bar rav shela: amar kera: "veshav el mishpachto" – lemuchezak shebbemishpachto.
Ibbaya lehu: eved ivri kohen, mahu sheyyimsor lo rabbo shifcha kenaanit? chiddush hu, la shena kohanim vela shena yisrael,
O dilma: shane kohanim hoil veribba bahen hakkatuv mitzvot yeterot? rav amar: muttar, ushemuel amar: asur.
Amar leh rav nachman lerav anan: ki havetu be mar shemuel, beiskumedre ittallelitu? may tama la temru leh meha: vachachamim omrim: en eved ivri kohen nirtza mippene shennaase baal mum.
Veim tomar en rabbo moser lo shifcha kenaanit, tippok li devaena: "ahavti et adoni et ishti veet banay" velekka, tu la middi.
Ibbaya lehu: kohen, mahu bifat toar? chiddush hu, la shena kohen vela shena yisrael, o dilma shane kohanim, hoil veribba bahen mitzvot yeterot? rav amar: muttar, ushemuel amar: asur.
Bevia rishona dechulle alma la peligi dishre, delo dibbera tora ella keneged yetzer hara.
Ki peligi bevia sheniyya, rav amar: muttar, ushemuel amar: asur. rav amar: muttar, hoil veishteray – ishteray. ushemuel amar: asur, deha havya la giyyoret, vegiyyoret lechohen la chazya.

Ikka deamri: bevia sheniyya kulle alma la peligi daasira, dehavya la giyyoret. ki peligi bevia rishona, rav amar: muttar, deha lo dibbera tora ella keneged yetzer hara, ushemuel amar: asur, kol hecha dekarena bay: "vahavetah el toch betecha" – karena bay: "veraita bashshivya". kol hecha dela karena bay: "vahavetah el toch betecha" – la karena bay: "veraita bashshivya".
Tanu rabbanan: "veraita bashshivya" – bishat shivyah. "eshet" – vaafillu eshet ish. "yefat toar" – lo dibbera tora ella keneged yetzer hara. mutav sheyyochlu yisrael besar

a: Temutot shechutot, veal yochlu besar temutot nevelot. "vechashakta" – af al pi sheenah naa. "bah" – velo bah uvachavertah.
"Velakachta" – likkuchin yesh lecha bah. "lecha leishsha" – shello yikkach shete nashim, achat lo veachat leaviv, achat lo veachat livno. "vahavetah" – melammed shello yilchatzenna bammilchama.
Tanu rabbanan: "im amor yomar" – ad sheyyomar veyishne. amar bitchillat shesh velo amar besof shesh – eno nirtza, shenneemar: "lo etze chofshi" – ad sheyyomar bishat yetzia.
Amar besof shesh velo amar bitchillat shesh – eno nirtza, shenneemar: "im amor yomar haeved" – ad sheyyomar keshehu eved.
Amar mar: amar bitchillat shesh velo amar besof shesh – eno nirtza, shenneemar: "lo etze chofshi". may irya, millo etze chofshi"? tippok leh devaenan: "ahavti et adoni et ishti veet banay" velekka!

Vetu, amar besof shesh velo amar bitchillat shesh eno nirtza, shenneemar "haeved". attu sof shesh lav eved hu? amar rava: may bitchillat shesh – bitchillat peruta acharona. umay besof shesh – besof peruta acharona.

Tanu rabbanan: lo ishsha uvanim, ulerabbo en ishsha uvanim – eno nirtza, shenneemar: "ki ahevcha veet betecha". lerabbo ishsha uvanim velo en ishsha uvanim – eno nirtza, shenneemar: "ahavti et adoni et ishti veet banay".

Hu ohev et rabbo verabbo eno ohavo – eno nirtza, shenneemar: "ki tov lo immach". rabbo ohavo vehu eno ohev et rabbo – eno nirtza, shenneemar: "ki ahevcha". hu chole verabbo eno chole – eno nirtza, shenneemar: "ki tov lo immach". rabbo chole vehu eno chole – eno nirtza, shenneemar: "immach".
Bae rav bivi bar abbaye: shenehem cholin, may? "immach" baenan – veha ikka, o dilma "ki tov lo immach" baenan – veha lekka? teku.

Tanu rabbanan: "ki tov lo immach" – immecha bammaachol, immecha bammishte. shello tehe atta ochel pat nekiyya vehu ochel pat kibbar, atta shote yayin yashan vehu shote yayin chadash, atta yashen al gabbe mochin vehu yashen al gabbe teven. mikkan amru: kol hakkone eved ivri – kekone adon leatzmo.

Tanu rabbanan: "veyatza meimmach hu uvanav immo", amar rabbi shimon: im hu nimkar – banav uvenotav mi nimkarim? mikkan sherabbo chayyayv bimzonot banav. kayyotze baddavar atta omer: "im baal ishsha hu veyatza ishto immo", amar rabbi shimon: im hu nimkar – ishto mi nimkera? mikkan sherabbo chayyayv bimzonot ishto.
Utzericha, dei ashmoinan banav, mishshum dela bene mebad umechal ninhu. aval ishto, devat mechal umebad hi, ema taaved vetechol.
Vei ashmeinan ishto, delav dirka lehaddore, aval banav, dedirkayyhu lehaddore, ema la, tzericha.
Tanu rabbanan:
b: Illu neemar "ozno baddelet", hayiti omer: yidkor keneged ozno baddelet. delet – in, ozno – la. veozen la? vehachtiv: "veratza adonav et ozno bammartzea"!
Ella: hayiti omer yirtzaenna laozen meabbaray veyannichenna al haddelet, veyidkor keneged ozno baddelet, talmud lomar: "beozno uvaddelet" – ha ketzad? doker veholech ad shemmaggia etzel delet.
"Delet" – shomea ani: ben akura ben sheenah akura, talmud lomar: "mezuza" – ma mezuza meummad – af delet name meummad.

Rabban yochanan ben zakkay haya doresh et hammikra hazze kemin chomer: ma nishtanna ozen mikkol evarim shebbagguf? amar hakkadosh baruch hu: ozen sheshshama koli al har sinay beshaa sheamarti: "ki li vene yisrael avadim" – velo avadim laavadim, vehalach ze vekana adon leatzmo – yeratza.

Verabbi shimon bar rabbi haya doresh et hammikra hazze kemin chomer: ma nishtanna delet umezuza mikkol kelim shebbabbayit? amar hakkadosh baruch hu: delet umezuza shehayu edim bemitzrayim beshaa sheppasachti al hammashkof veal shete hammezuzot, veamarti: "ki li vene yisrael avadim" – velo avadim laavadim, vehotzetim meavdut lecherut, vehalach ze vekana adon leatzmo – yeratza bifnehem.

Mishna eved kenaani nikne bechesef uvishtar uvachazaka, vekone et atzmo bechesef al yede acherim, uvishtar al yede atzmo, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: bechesef al yede atzmo uvishtar al yede acherim, uvilvad sheyyehe hakkesef mishshel acherim.

Gemara menalan? dichtiv: "vehitnachaltem otam livnechem acharechem lareshet achuzza" – hikkishan hakkatuv lisde achuzza. ma sede achuzza nikne bechesef, bishtar, uvachazaka – af eved kenaani nikne bechesef bishtar uvachazaka.
I ma sede achuzza chozeret labbealim bayyovel – af eved kenaani chozer labbealim bayyovel? – talmud lomar: "leolam bahem taavodu".
Tana: af bachalifin. vetanna didan? milleta deleta bemittaltelin – katane, milleta deita bimtaltelin – la katane.
Amar shemuel: eved kenaani nikne bimshicha. ketzad? tekafo uva etzlo – kenao. kerao uva etzlo – lo kenao.

Bishlama letanna didan, milleta deita bemittaltele – la katane, deleta bemittaltele – katane. ella letanna bara, nitne meshicha! ki katane, milleta deita ben bimkarkee ben bemittalteli, meshicha divmittalteli ita, bimkarkei leta – la katane.

Ketzad? tekafo uva etzlo – kenao, kerao uva etzlo – lo kenao. ukerao la? vehatanya: ketzad bimsira? achazah betalpah, bisarah, baukkaf shealeha, bishlif shealeha, bifrumebya shebbefiha uvezog shebbetzavvarah – kenaah.
Ketzad bimshicha? kore lah vehi baa, o shehikkishah bemakkel veratzta lefanav, kevan sheakra yad varegel – kenaah. rabbi assi veamri la rabbi acha omer: ad shettehallech lefanav melo komatah.
Amri: behema addata demara azla, eved addateh denafsheh kaazel. amar rav ashe: eved katan kivhema dame.

Tanu rabbanan: ketzad bachazaka? hittir lo minalo, o holich kelav acharav levet hammerchatz, hifshito, hirchitzo, sacho, gerdo, hilbisho hinilo, higbiho – kenao. amar rabbi shimon: lo tehe chazaka gedola mehagebaha, shehagebaha kona bechol makom. may kaamar?
Amar rav ashe: higbiho hu lerabbo – kenao, higbiho rabbo lo – lo kenao. amar rabbi shimon: lo tehe chazaka gedola mehagebaha, shehagebaha kona bechol makom.
Hasheta deamrat: higbiho hu lerabbo – kenao, ella meatta shifcha kenaanit tikkane bevia? ki kaamrinan: ze nehene veze mitztaer, hacha: ze nehene veze nehene hu.
Shello kedarkah may ikka lememar? amar rav achayy [bar adda] demin acha: man lema lan delav hanaa it lehu letarvayyhu? veod: "mishkeve ishsha" ketiv, hikkisho hakkatuv kedarkah leshello kedarkah.
Rabbi yehuda hindua ger sheen lo yorshin hava. chalash, al mar zutera leshayyole beh, chazyeh detakef leh alma tuva. amar leh leavdeh: shelof li mesanay veamtinhu leveta. ikka deamri gadol hava.

a: Ze perash lemita, veze perash lechayyim.

Veikka deamri katan hava, udela keabba shaul, detanya: ger shemmet uvizbezu yisrael nechasav, vehayu bahen avadim, ben gedolim ben ketannim – kanu atzman bene chorin. abba shaul omer: gedolim – kanu atzman bene chorin, ketannim – kol hammachzik bahen zacha bahen.

Vekone atzmo bechesef kulei bechesef al yede acherim. in, aval lo al yede atzmo. bemay askinan? ilema shello middato, mikkede shemana leh lerabbi meir deamar: chov hu leeved sheyyetze miyyad rabbo lecherut. utenena: zachin laadam shello befanav, veen chavin lo ella befanav.
Ella peshita middato, veha kamashma lan: al yede acherim – in, al yede atzmo – la. alma en kinyan leeved belo rabbo.
I hachi, ema sefa: bishtar al yede atzmo. al yede atzmo – in, al yede acherim – la. vei middato, al yede acherim ammay la?
Vechi tema: may al yede atzmo – af al yede atzmo, veha ka mashma lan: degitto veyado baim keechad, veha la tane hachi, detanya: bishtar al yede atzmo velo al yede acherim, divre rabbi meir!
Amar abbaye: leolam shello middato, veshane kesef, hoil vekane leh beal kurecheh – makne leh beal kurecheh.
I hachi, shetar name! hay shetara lechod vehay shetara lechod.
Hacha name, hay kaspa lechod vehay kaspa lechod? tiva miha chad hu.
Rava amar: kesef – kabbalat rabbo garma lo, shetar – kabbalat acherim garma lo.

Vachachamim omrim: bechesef al yede atzmo. bechesef al yede atzmo – in, al yede acherim – la. ammay? nehi name deshello middato, mikkede shemana lehu lerabbanan deamri: zechut hu sheyyetze mittachat yad rabbo lecherut, utenena: zachin leadam shello befanav, veen chavin lo ella befanav.

Vechi tema: may al yede atzmo – af al yede atzmo, veka mashma lan deyesh kinyan leeved belo rabbo – i hachi, ema sefa: bishtar al yede acherim – velo al yede atzmo, veha kayyma lan degitto veyado bain keechad?

Vechi tema: may al yede acherim – af al yede acherim, veha ka mashma lan dizchut hu leeved sheyyetze miyyad rabbo lecherut, i hachi, nearvinhu venitninhu: bechesef uvishtar ben al yede acherim ben al yede atzmo!

Ella: bechesef – ben al yede acherim ben al yede atzmo, bishtar – al yede acherim velo al yede atzmo. verabbi shimon ben elazar hu, detanya rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: af bishtar al yede acherim velo al yede atzmo. veshalosh machlokot baddavar.
Amar rabba: may tama derabbi shimon ben elazar – gamar "lah" "lah" meishsha: ma ishsha ad sheyyotzi get lirshut sheenah shello, af eved name ad sheyyotzi get lirshut sheenah shello.
Bae rabba:
b: Lerabbi shimon ben elazar, eved kenaani mahu sheyyaase shaliach lekabbel gitto miyyad rabbo? kevan degamar "lah" "lah" meishsha, keishsha,

O dilma ishsha deihi matze mekabbelet gittah – shaliach name matze meshavveya. eved deihu la mekabbel gitteh – shaliach name la matze meshavve. batar devaya hadar pashta: "lah" "lah" meishsha, keishsha.
Veella ha deamar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: hane kahane sheluche derachamana ninhu. dei salka datach sheluche didan ninhu, mi ikka midde daanan la matzenan avdinan veinhu matze avdi?
Vela?! veha avda, deihu la matze mekabbel gitteh usheliach matze meshavve!
Vela hi, yisrael la shaychi betorat korbanot kelal, eved shayech begittin. detanya: nirin haddevarim shehaeved mekabbel gitto shel chavero miyyad rabbo shel chavero, aval lo miyyad rabbo shello.

Uvilvad sheyyehe hakkesef mishshel acherim. nema beha kamippalgi: derabbi meir savar: en kinyan leeved belo rabbo, veen kinyan leishsha belo balah. verabbanan savri: yesh kinyan leeved belo rabbo, veyesh kinyan leishsha belo balah.

Amar rabba amar rav sheshet: dechulle alma en kinyan leeved belo rabbo, veen kinyan leishsha belo balah. vehacha bemay askinan, deakni leh acher mane, vaamar leh: "al menat sheen lerabbach reshut bo".
Rabbi meir savar: ki amar leh "keni" – kane eved vekane rabbeh. vechi amar leh "al menat" – lo kelum kaamar leh. verabbanan savri: kevan deamar leh "al menat" – ahani leh tenaeh.
Verabbi elazar amar: kol ki hay gavvna dechulle alma la peligi dekane eved vekane rabbeh, vehacha bemay askinan, kegon deakni leh acher mane vaamar leh: "al menat shettetze bo lecherut".

Rabbi meir savar: ki amar leh "keni" – kane eved vekane rabbeh. vechi amar leh "al menat" – lo kelum kaamar leh. verabbanan savri: ledideh name ha la ka makne leh, deha la amar leh ella "al menat shettetze bo lecherut".
